notes.title: April Fools' Day Event! Pandora's Boxes and Fools Chests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/5a3d6372dcc08487be02b0aa46e01ce19b3d2058.png[/img]

[i]Crows behave very strangely, this is a bad omen…[/i]

Also during the Iron Deposits mining, you can disturb the evil Woodwose miner. In Woodwose miners loot, you can find ore, various hats, as well as the legendary Fools chest! Which is guaranteed to contain one of all the existing hats in the game, and if the hat has quality, then it will be 150%!
In the Fools Chest, there are even unique hats from all the game events: Witch's Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Lucky Hat, and Christmas Hat. Try your luck!

[h3]Fools' Day Event:[/h3]
- If you manage to shoot the crow in time, then there is a small chance of getting a huge rarity - Pandora's Box!
- Iron deposits at the time of the event are visible to everyone, regardless of the level of Mining.
- The number of crows in the game has been increased.
- Barghests love to eat crows, and sometimes you can find Pandora's Box in their stomach.
- Pandora's Boxes can also be found in Locked Chests and chests for daily rewards.  
- Helmets of 160 quality can now be found in Fools Chests!

[i]The event will last until April 15, 2025 (inclusive).[/i]

tags.feature: - Helmets of 160 quality can now be found in Fools Chests!

notes.title: St.Wodwose's Day event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/24d2d5e6b2c51c7ee0ef2d1b189d5ce8fb72cd9a.png[/img]

Begin to celebrate St.Wodwose's Day in the world of Wild Terra. It's time to try your luck!

For a long time, miners have noticed that in early spring, when mining ore, you can encounter small green wodwose. They are very shy and run away immediately, but because of their prey they run slowly and it is usually not difficult to defeat them. Take a look in their bag! You will receive an additional amount of random ore (including iron and thozorium!). Besides the ore, the Wodwose always carry the rare Lucky Four-leaf Clover with them. Also, clover can now be caught when picking wild flowers, and especially lucky ones can find lucky clover flowers.

[h3]St.Wodwose's Day Event:[/h3]
- When mining any ore, there is a chance to encounter small green Wodwose.
- When collecting any wild flowers, there is a chance to find a rare type of lucky four-leaf clover.
- Lucky four-leaf clover has begun to grow in the world, real lucky ones will be able to find it.
- In the "Craft" window, the "Saint Wodwose Day" tab has appeared. There, you can make unique items and event food with the help of the lucky clover.

[i]The event will last until March 27th.[/i]

notes.title: Christmas and New Year Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/2c6f459103b041761282eca69f8a92af2d7d358b.png[/img]

[i]Will last until January 9, 2025![/i]

Winter has come in the Wild Terra world. Snow fell, ponds were covered with ice and became passable. Collect snow, make snowballs, arrange snow battles.

But something is wrong here... The inhabitants of the Corrupted Lands decided to wreck Christmas! A group of Woodwoses under the leadership of Grandfather Alfar in every possible way tries to interfere with the holiday, they cut down trees, steal Christmas decorations and Christmas presents. The holiday is at stake! Evil must be stopped!
Unfortunately, the monsters are protected by the strongest shamanic magic and only a snow fight is able to stop them... The victory over the Christmas Woodwoses will give you various materials and decorations for the holiday, and if you take away "Stolen Christmas Gifts" from them, you can return them through auction and get valuable Christmas items!

- Decorate your dominium with Christmas decorations, and don't forget to set up a Christmas tree to receive gifts. First, you need to cut a good fir tree. But it’s not so simple, so prepare your very best ax and be patient. You can also try growing your fir tree forest to increase the chance of catching a good Christmas tree. After installing the Christmas tree, you can decorate it with toys and receive gifts for it (you can decorate a tree every 18 hours).
- To receive a Christmas gift from Santa Claus, you need to install a Christmas sock in your dominium and put snowflakes in it. The more snowflakes you put, the better the gift will be. Collect as many snowflakes as possible, and only then open the sock to see what lies there.
- Log in from January 1st to January 3rd, find the Royal Christmas Tree and claim your gift!
- Added "Stolen Christmas Gifts" to the loot of any type of treasure map.
- When opening locked Bronze, Iron and Steel chests you can get “Snowflakes”.

notes.title: Halloween Event in Wild Terra Online!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/a61e123dd42efbc6e0f5a4cc43a3d01df8ee326e.png[/img]

Cursed trees have begun to grow in the world, which can be decorated with Jack-O-Lanterns. Defeat the monsters that appear and receive a unique reward. Wild Pumpkins have also started to grow, so be careful when gathering them. A Headless Guard has appeared in the Corrupted Lands; defeating him will not be so easy, so call your friends and prepare for battle. If you still manage to defeat him, then you will have a chance to receive unique types of armor and the Headless Guard's Fire Horse mount, as well as other, no less interesting items. You can plant a House Cursed Tree Sprout in your dominium, and if you take care of it, it can grow into a House Halloween Tree. If you decorate this tree with Jack O'Lanterns, it will remove all curses and you will get the unique Jack's Protection effect. Complete quests, collect cursed brains and exchange them for unique and rare event rewards through the auction!

[h3]Changes and Fixes:[/h3]  
- A new unique frame for portraits has been added.  
- The ability to purchase multiple event items at once in the auction has been added.  
- The maximum time for "Eat Everything" has been reduced to 5 seconds.  
- Fixed a bug related to item splitting when the inventory is full.  
- Fixed a bug with the dodge calculation for Thozorium light armor.

notes.title: End of Ranked Season 1 in Wild Terra Online!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/24d2d5e6b2c51c7ee0ef2d1b189d5ce8fb72cd9a.png[/img]

So the first season of the rating in the world of Wild Terra Online has come to an end, all players who have scored the required number of points can receive their rewards in the rating window. Separately, we want to congratulate our first "Legends" on all servers, the players who made great efforts and spent a lot of time to take 1st place in the overall ranking. Your names will forever remain in the history of the game!

Everyone who did not have time to participate or did not take high places should not be upset, because new seasons are ahead, which will be more interesting and exciting. Follow the news!

Important! Rewards must be claimed before the start of the next season. Also, before the start of the new season, the receipt of rating points was stopped and the rating table was closed.

__Other game changes:__
- All sling shells now work correctly.
- Fixed bugs in quests and localization.
- Fixed a bug with some buildings, when they could be built outside the dominium.
- Fixed stamina cost bug when building.
- Fixed bugs in the game interface in the Steam client.

notes.title: Getting ready for the end of Wild Terra Online ranking Season 1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/68712b0956da8d33fb070656f65999d188c9235b.png[/img]

In a month, or rather on July 20, 2023, the first season of the rating in the game will end. All players will be able to get rewards for their achievements in the General, PvE and PvP rankings. More details on awards, standings and prizes will be posted next week. Follow the news.

[u]Other changes in the game:[/u]
- Balance of loot in Ritual Circle, Draemeter and Royal Treasures. Added a chance to receive Thosorium Ingots.
- A broken merchant's wagon. Increased the chance to get more valuable loot and added a new type of loot - Melee Weapons.
- Added new improvements for the pickaxe for mining ore - 5 pcs. (This can be found in various treasures).
- A new resource has been added to the castle taxes - Clay.
- Decreased stamina cost when attacking with axe, sword and heavy weapons.
- Added a new unique bonus "Rage X% - a chance that an additional 10 damage will be dealt when hit."
- Added a new type of heavy and light armor with unique tags and bonuses - Ritual thosorium armor (you can find it in the Ritual circle).
- Added master's marks to the battle sling.
- Rotation of loot in locked chests, mounts and cloaks have been replaced with new ones.
- Fixed typos in quest locales.
- Optimized graphics for item icons.

notes.title: Christmas and New Year Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/4d7dc36ddd2abe0fc63b227d1e3672ef0ac0e42f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Christmas and New Year Event[/h2]
[i]Will last until January 10, 2023![/i]

Winter has come in the Wild Terra world. Snow fell, ponds were covered with ice and became passable. Collect snow, make snowballs, arrange snow battles.
But something is wrong here ... The inhabitants of the Corrupted Lands decided to wreck Christmas! A group of Woodwoses under the leadership of Grandfather Alfar in every possible way tries to interfere with the holiday, they cut down trees, steal Christmas decorations and Christmas presents. The holiday is at stake! Evil must be stopped!
Unfortunately, the monsters are protected by the strongest shamanic magic and only a snow fight is able to stop them ... The victory over the Christmas Woodwoses will give you various materials and decorations for the holiday, and if you take away "Stolen Christmas Gifts" from them, you can return them through auction and get valuable Christmas items!

- Decorate your dominium with Christmas decorations, and don't forget to set up a Christmas tree to receive gifts. First, you need to cut a good fir tree. But it’s not so simple, so prepare your very best ax and be patient. You can also try growing your fir tree forest to increase the chance of catching a good Christmas tree. After installing the Christmas tree, you can decorate it with toys and receive gifts for it (you can decorate a tree every 18 hours).
- To receive a Christmas gift from Santa Claus, you need to install a Christmas sock in your dominium and put snowflakes in it. The more snowflakes you put, the better the gift will be. Collect as many snowflakes as possible, and only then open the sock to see what lies there.
- Log in from January 1st to January 3rd, find the Royal Christmas Tree and claim your gift!

[h3]What's new in this event:[/h3]
- New event currency mechanics. Now any event currency, upon receipt, will not take up extra space in the inventory, but will be displayed separately as an additional resource. It is also important to remember that at the end of the event, all event currency will be removed, so make sure you spend it all!
- Added 5 new daily Christmas quests. You can only receive one quest per day.
- Added 4 new Christmas character portraits. You can find them in the Christmas box.
- Added 4 new statues of different animals. They will change their appearance depending on the season. You can find them in the Christmas box.
- Added 2 new plants for decoration. They will change their appearance depending on the season. You can find them in the Christmas box.
- Added 3 new "Christmas sock" decorations on the back. You can find them in the Christmas box.
- Added new "Christmas hats" (3 colors) with a unique bonus. You can find them in the Christmas box or buy them at the auction.
- Added a new "Christmas Box" with new items inside. Also, last year's "Christmas Box” remained in the game, but now it is impossible to get new event items from it.
- Added a new type of mob "Grinch Helper Woodwose", which can appear when completing orders from Santa and interfere with you by throwing snowballs.
- Added a new type of winter animals (Deer, Boar, Wolf, Bear) that can be caught and tamed.
- Christmas and white mounts can be exchanged for "Christmas boxes".
- Small changes in the crafting and construction of event items and buildings.
- Added "Stolen Christmas Presents" to the loot of any type of treasure map.
- When opening locked Bronze, Iron and Steel chests, you can get "Snowflakes".
- Stolen Christmas gifts can be used by players to trade in the auction.

[h3]Changes to Santa's Unique Quest Chain:[/h3]
- A new character portrait has been added as a reward.
- Added a Christmas sock as a reward that can be hung on your back.
- A new unique building "Caramel Oven" has been added as a reward.

[h3]Other game changes:[/h3]
- Interface. Furnaces now display the required fuel to run them.
- Interface. Separation of quests in the journal into "Main" and "Event".
- Added a chance to find different keys to locked chests when butchering animal leaders.
- Increased vein requirement in some crafting recipes.
- Reduced production of veins when butchering animals.
- Reduced the amount of tin in rewards and godsends.
- Changed spawn times for Ritual, Warp Crystal and Draemeter to be more random.
- Fixed a bug with looping sounds when mining resources.
- Fixed a bug with the daily quest "The Terrible Scarecrow".

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/e36b528ad96c94f24775cb79ff6267cc7b0884a2.png[/img]

[h3]Halloween 2022[/h3]
- Cursed trees have begun to grow, on which you can hang Jack's Lantern to decorate. Each decoration calls the guards, which must be killed in order to be able to act further. After completely decorating and destroying all the waves of guards, you will receive a reward.
- "Wild Pumpkins" have started to grow in the world, be careful when gathering it.
- The "Headless Guard" has appeared in the Corrupted Lands, it will not be so easy to defeat him, so call your friends and get better prepared for battle. If you still manage to defeat him, then you will have a chance to get a unique mount "Headless Guard's Fire Horse", as well as other interesting items.
- Halloween items have been added to the auction in the “Events” tab, which can be purchased for “Unholy Bones”. It can be obtained from Unholy Monsters (Unholy Rat and Barghest also include).
- “Unholy brains” are no longer needed, but you can exchange them for “Unholy bones” at the auction. You can also put up goods for sale to other players for these bones.
- In your dominium, you can plant a "Sprout of a cursed home tree", and if you take care of it, then a "Home Halloween tree" can grow from it. If you decorate this tree with "Jack's Lanterns", it will remove all curses and you will receive a unique effect "Jack's Defense".
- Added a chain of Halloween quests, for completing which you can get the unique title Nightmarish.
- Halloween pets and mounts can be exchanged for Demon Chests.
- Added "Demonic Chests" to the Royal Treasure, Ritual Circle and Draemeter rewards.
- Added "Unholy Bones" as a reward for daily quests.
- Added "Unholy Bones" to the rat hole reward.

[i][b]Event date: from October 13, 2022 to November 03, 2022[/b][/i]

[h3]New items, decor and balance:[/h3]
- Added wild-growing pumpkin that will grow all over the world during the event, and gathering home pumpkin will not give any result.
- Minor changes to the Halloween quest chain.
- The strength of all cursed monsters and animals has been changed, they have become slightly weaker, but now they can put a curse on the player when they die.
- Added a full set of heavy armor "Headless Guard" and light "Witch armor", you can find them by killing the "Headless Guard".
- The reward in the "Demonic chests" and the corpse of the "Headless Guard" has been balanced, now the chance to get a unique item from the corpse is 33%, and in the chest 60%.
- Added 4 new Halloween avatars. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest" by exchanging bones at the auction or by killing the "Headless Guard".
- Added 4 new Halloween decors "Unholy tree" that you can decorate your yard and they will not disappear after the end of this event. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Added 3 types of new Halloween sweets. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Now, while any curse hangs on the player, he is considered "Unholy" and all the rules for unholy monsters apply to him.
- Added new bonuses "Damage to Unholy" and "Unholy Armor" for items.
- Added 6 new upgrades for weapons and armor with new bonuses. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- During the celebration of the event, the chance of getting unholy marks is increased when crafting armor and weapons with a master's mark.

[h3]Other changes and fixes:[/h3]
- Added 3 unique back decorations (Swords). You can find them in royal and epic treasure rewards.
- Increased the cooldown of Dodge by 1 second (from 5 to 6 seconds).
- Increased the cooldown of Parry by 1 second (from 6 to 7 seconds).
- Increased stamina cost for dodge and block arrows.
- Light shields. Shield Bash can only be used with melee weapons.
- Improved Fruit Juice stats: duration from 30 to 45 minutes, bonus from 25 to 30%.
- Balanced the reward of the Ritual Circle and Draemeter, removed all trash loot.
- Fixed a bug with checking guards in godsends.
- Minor UI and item tooltips improvements.

notes.title: Major update. Light shields, PvE events, dominium aging and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/59942af7aec266c687275e4007a50eeaa001908f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Combat skills:[/h3]
- A new skill "Light Shields" has been added, and the old skill "Shields" has been renamed to "Heavy Shields". Players in light armor can now officially run with shields :)
- Light shields now have the "Shield Bash" ability, which deals small damage and gives the player the "Stun" effect (the player cannot block, parry, dodge).
- Heavy shields. Now each skill level grants 0.5% block.
- Heavy armor. Now each level of the skill gives 0.5% armor.
- Light armor. Now each skill level grants 0.5% dodge and 0.2% armor.
- Swords. Each skill level now grants 0.4% Parry, 0.5% Damage, and 0.1% Crit Chance.
- Axes. Now each skill level grants 0.75% damage and 0.14% crit chance.
- Crushing. Each skill level now grants 0.1% Parry, 1% Damage and 0.08% Crit Chance.
- Knives. Each skill level now grants 0.5% Parry, 1% Damage, and 0.5% Crit Chance.
- Throwing. Now each skill level grants 1% damage and 0.1% crit chance.
- Bows. Now each skill level grants 0.75% damage and 0.36% crit chance.
- Improved the "Combat skills" interface, now you can see information about the bonuses that each combat skill gives when using it.
- Reduced the range of the Charge ability from 6 to 4.

[h3]PvE events and activities:[/h3]
- "Leaders" of some wild animals (Deer, Boar, Wolf, Bear) appeared in the world. From the corpse of such a leader, you can be guaranteed to get a head, but be careful, these animals are very dangerous.
- A new object "Broken merchant's wagon" has appeared in the world. This is a group event in which you will need to not only fight off waves of mobs, but also repair the wagon itself using various items and tools. As a reward, you can get the resources that the merchant transported, the list of resources will be different each time, but united by a common type. For example, as a reward, you can get a wagon stuffed with different ore, leather or ingots of different metals.
- A new object "Rat's Nest" has appeared in the world. This is a new mini-event, for one or more players. You will need to fight off waves of rats, and possibly meet the Rat Queen. As a reward, the player will be able to receive random items from the "Lost Items" list. This is a new mechanic in the game, now any item thrown on the ground with a 50% chance when removed will fall into a separate general list of items. Also, all items from the destruction of dominiums and from the corpses of players (who did not have time to pick up) will fall into this list. So you have a chance to get someone's lost items. It is important to understand that the list will be common for all items, and do not be surprised if you suddenly find only sticks and stones in the nest, because rats pull everything into their nest.
- For all godsends in the game, the requirements for opening them have been changed, in some you will need to kill the guards, in some you need a tool to open.
- Reduced the activity time of any treasure from 8 to 3 hours.
- Now, when searching for some treasures, you will need to follow several signs. And also the treasures themselves have changed their appearance and can be under stones and trees.
- A new type of treasure "Epic Treasure" has appeared. It's better to gather a group of players to dig it out!
- New guards in the Royal Treasures and slightly changed the reward!
- Circle Ritual, Warp Crystal and Draemeter now spawn with a random timer.

[h3]Changes to Siege and Castle Auction:[/h3]
- You can no longer build siege structures outside of a siege.
- After the end of the siege, all siege structures are removed.
- A new type "Wooden stakes" has been added to siege structures, they block the passage, but do not block arrows.
- Added a minimum bid for bidding on the auction, now you can't bid on the auction less than this amount.
- A "Blacksmith" has been added to the castle, which can repair all items worn by the player for spices. This service is available to all members of the guild (which owns this castle) with the rank of "Knight" and above. Important, the number of repairs is limited, but the repair counter is reset after each siege or auction for castles.

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- The "Dominium aging" mechanic has returned to the game, while it is enabled only for small and medium-sized dominiums, in the future it will affect all dominiums as before. So don't forget to log into the game if you want to prolong the life of your dominium!
- Now, when the dominium is destroyed, a message will be written to the global chat for all players. So that they can start looking for such dominiums and try to find something valuable there.
- When resurrected with a scroll of "Rebirth", now satiety will be replenished up to 80%.
- Now any uncooked food is considered "raw food", which restores satiety only up to the level of 50%.
- The minimum distance between dominiums is now 7 tiles for all servers.
- Now some animals and monsters can deal damage through the player's block, as well as inflict an instant counter-hit when taking damage.
- Increased feeding time for some animals when tamed.
- Made the description of the feeding time in the animal tooltip more understandable.
- Increased the maximum level of cartography to 40.
- A new epic treasure map has been added to crafting.
- Added a new type of shields "Light shields". They protect against arrows and projectiles well, and you can also parry attacks with them, but the chance to block an attack is not very high. These shields are suitable for light and fast players.
- All wooden shields have had their durability significantly increased.
- Lightweight and reinforced wooden shields have been added to crafting (they will have their own list of bonuses for the master's mark).
- New light shields of Vikings and Guardians have been added to the loot of some treasures.
- Added a new decoration on the back "Ritual Bones", it can be worn instead of a cloak.
- Added new decor for the dominium, the statues of Lions and the Conquistador. You can find them in the Royal Treasure.
- Added new decor for the dominium, flags on the wall and flags on the pole. You can find them in the Royal Treasure.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with a negative critical hit value.
- Fixed a bug in the Castle Auction interface.
- Fixed "Too many commands" error when the player tried to collect taxes in the castle.

tags.feature: - "Leaders" of some wild animals (Deer, Boar, Wolf, Bear) appeared in the world. From the corpse of such a leader, you can be guaranteed to get a head, but be careful, these animals are very dangerous.

- A new object "Broken merchant's wagon" has appeared in the world. This is a group event in which you will need to not only fight off waves of mobs, but also repair the wagon itself using various items and tools. As a reward, you can get the resources that the merchant transported, the list of resources will be different each time, but united by a common type. For example, as a reward, you can get a wagon stuffed with different ore, leather or ingots of different metals.

- A new object "Rat's Nest" has appeared in the world. This is a new mini-event, for one or more players. You will need to fight off waves of rats, and possibly meet the Rat Queen. As a reward, the player will be able to receive random items from the "Lost Items" list. This is a new mechanic in the game, now any item thrown on the ground with a 50% chance when removed will fall into a separate general list of items. Also, all items from the destruction of dominiums and from the corpses of players (who did not have time to pick up) will fall into this list. So you have a chance to get someone's lost items. It is important to understand that the list will be common for all items, and do not be surprised if you suddenly find only sticks and stones in the nest, because rats pull everything into their nest.

tags.balance_change: - For all godsends in the game, the requirements for opening them have been changed, in some you will need to kill the guards, in some you need a tool to open.
- Reduced the activity time of any treasure from 8 to 3 hours.
- Now, when searching for some treasures, you will need to follow several signs. And also the treasures themselves have changed their appearance and can be under stones and trees.

tags.feature: - A new type of treasure "Epic Treasure" has appeared. It's better to gather a group of players to dig it out!

tags.balance_change: - New guards in the Royal Treasures and slightly changed the reward!
- Circle Ritual, Warp Crystal and Draemeter now spawn with a random timer.
- You can no longer build siege structures outside of a siege.
- After the end of the siege, all siege structures are removed.

tags.feature: - A new type "Wooden stakes" has been added to siege structures, they block the passage, but do not block arrows.

tags.balance_change: - Added a minimum bid for bidding on the auction, now you can't bid on the auction less than this amount.

tags.feature: - A "Blacksmith" has been added to the castle, which can repair all items worn by the player for spices. This service is available to all members of the guild (which owns this castle) with the rank of "Knight" and above. Important, the number of repairs is limited, but the repair counter is reset after each siege or auction for castles.

- The "Dominium aging" mechanic has returned to the game, while it is enabled only for small and medium-sized dominiums, in the future it will affect all dominiums as before. So don't forget to log into the game if you want to prolong the life of your dominium!
- Now, when the dominium is destroyed, a message will be written to the global chat for all players. So that they can start looking for such dominiums and try to find something valuable there.

tags.balance_change: - When resurrected with a scroll of "Rebirth", now satiety will be replenished up to 80%.
- Now any uncooked food is considered "raw food", which restores satiety only up to the level of 50%.
- The minimum distance between dominiums is now 7 tiles for all servers.
- Now some animals and monsters can deal damage through the player's block, as well as inflict an instant counter-hit when taking damage.
- Increased feeding time for some animals when tamed.
- Made the description of the feeding time in the animal tooltip more understandable.
- Increased the maximum level of cartography to 40.

tags.feature: - A new epic treasure map has been added to crafting.

- Added a new type of shields "Light shields". They protect against arrows and projectiles well, and you can also parry attacks with them, but the chance to block an attack is not very high. These shields are suitable for light and fast players.

tags.balance_change: - All wooden shields have had their durability significantly increased.

tags.feature: - Lightweight and reinforced wooden shields have been added to crafting (they will have their own list of bonuses for the master's mark).
- New light shields of Vikings and Guardians have been added to the loot of some treasures.
- Added a new decoration on the back "Ritual Bones", it can be worn instead of a cloak.
- Added new decor for the dominium, the statues of Lions and the Conquistador. You can find them in the Royal Treasure.
- Added new decor for the dominium, flags on the wall and flags on the pole. You can find them in the Royal Treasure.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug with a negative critical hit value.
- Fixed a bug in the Castle Auction interface.
- Fixed "Too many commands" error when the player tried to collect taxes in the castle.

notes.title: In the world of Wild Terra, the sacred season of Fertility and Rebirth is coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/4848a559782e38537c9266b3f2e59ea3110a039c.png[/img]

Easter Bunnies leave "Mysterious Eggs" of different colors everywhere. These eggs have different unique bonuses and when eating eggs there is a rare chance to find the Mysterious Needle, which gives the Rebirth effect and the unique title Reborn when it is used! Also in the Auction Events section, Mysterious Eggs can be exchanged for holiday items and some resources.
Harmful poachers started hunting Easter bunnies, and set traps everywhere for them. Thwart the poachers and free the bunnies from the traps, but be careful, there may be hungry wolves around such traps.

Sacred hares also appeared in the forests. If you are lucky to shoot him, then the Sacred Duck will appear from him. One of the legends said that there is a chance to get immortality if you kill such a duck. But for killing sacred animals, you can get a curse!

[h3]Event changes:[/h3]
- Expanded the chain of Easter quests to 23 tasks.
- Increased the number of Mystery Eggs per stack to 200.
- Added a new unique decor: Baskets with flowers and Statues of Angels, you can find them in the "Easter chests".
- New holiday food "Easter Cookies" has been added, you can find them in "Easter Chests".
- Added a new unique building "Easter Bunny in a Basket", if fed, it will bring mysterious eggs. You can get such a building for completing the chain of Easter quests.
- In the Disputed Lands you can find a large rabbit hole, try putting a carrot next to it.
- Mysterious Eggs have been added to the auction currency and can be used to sell items.
- Easter pets and mounts can be exchanged for chests.
- Mysterious eggs can be found in daily quest chests.

[b]The event will last until 05/05/2022 (inclusive).[/b]

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with high durability costs when hitting the Draemeter.
- In auctions for castles, there is now a minimum bid of 50 spices, you cannot bid less than this amount.
- Chests for daily quests can no longer be taken out of the inventory.

notes.title: April Fools' Day Event! Pandora's Boxes and Fools Chests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/c3711e4731d3ba0efb8ccfb2e71a8724cd12be43.png[/img]

[i]Crows behave very strangely, this is a bad omen…[/i]

Also during the Iron Deposits mining, you can disturb the evil Woodwose miner. In Woodwose miners loot, you can find ore, various hats, as well as the legendary Fools chest! Which is guaranteed to contain one of all the existing hats in the game, and if the hat has quality, then it will be 150%!
In the Fools Chest, there are even unique hats from all the game events: Witch's Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Lucky Hat, and Christmas Hat. Try your luck!

[b]Fools' Day Event:[/b]
- If you manage to shoot the crow in time, then there is a small chance of getting a huge rarity - Pandora's Box!
- Iron deposits at the time of the event are visible to everyone, regardless of the level of Mining.
- The number of crows in the game has been increased.
- Barghests love to eat crows, and sometimes you can find Pandora's Box in their stomach.
- Some Robbers and Woodwoses have hidden their Pandora's Boxes in treasures, try to collect the treasure map to find it.

[i]The event will last until 04/05/2022 (inclusive).[/i]

notes.title: St.Wodwose's Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/d7fa620cf362d438c8d9ab00ae5993e4c62b2352.jpg[/img]

Begin to celebrate St.Wodwose's Day in the world of Wild Terra. It's time to try your luck!

For a long time, miners have noticed that in early spring, when mining ore, you can encounter small green wodwose. They are very shy and run away immediately, but because of their prey they run slowly and it is usually not difficult to defeat them. Take a look in their bag! You will receive an additional amount of random ore (including iron and thozorium!). Besides the ore, the Wodwose always carry the rare Lucky Four-leaf Clover with them. Also, clover can now be caught when picking wild flowers, and especially lucky ones can find lucky clover flowers.

[b]Special offer! Bag with 3,333 gold at a bargain price in the ingame store![/b]

[h3]St.Wodwose's Day Event![/h3]
- When mining any ore, there is a chance to encounter small green Wodwose.
- When collecting any wild flowers, there is a chance to find a rare type of lucky four-leaf clover.
- Lucky four-leaf clover has begun to grow in the world, real lucky ones will be able to find it.
- In the "Craft" window, the "Saint Wodwose Day" tab has appeared. There, you can make unique items and event food with the help of the lucky clover.
- Added Green Woodwos Chest to Draemetr, Ritual Circle and Royal Treasure loot.

The event will run until 03/23/2022 (inclusive)!

notes.title: Lady's Day in Wild Terra Online!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/085e90b88d31cc604ddf7c3b1a76c4e637e2f86e.jpg[/img]

Congratulations to all women on International Women's Day on March 8! We wish that every moment of your life brings a sea of happiness, warmth, smiles and wonderful mood!

[b]Lady's Day Event:[/b]
- Beautiful flowers began to grow in the world - Gerbera, Chrysanthemum, Hydrangea. It’s can only be gathered during the event.
- In the "Craft" window, there is a new tab "Lady's Day". There you can make delicious heart-shaped cookies and sew a beautiful "Lady's Cloak" (only female characters can wear them) for your lady of the heart.
- When you create a "Lady's Cloak", you can get a unique title "In Love".
- Chest with gifts for a Lady has been added to the in-game store. In it you can find all the items from this event.
- At the auction in the "Events" tab, you can exchange flowers for a "Chest with gifts for the Lady" and a unique decor.
- Added "Chest with gifts for a Lady" to the loot of Draemetr, Ritual Circle and Royal Treasure.
- Added 9 new decoration "Vase with flower" (you can only find it in the "Chest with gifts for a Lady").
- Added 5 new decoration "Round flower bed with flowers" (you can buy it in Auction in "Events" tab).
- Added 3 new dishes (you can only find it in the "Chest with gifts for a Lady").
- Added unique effect "Gift Lover".
[i]
The event will run until March 14, 2022 (inclusive)![/i]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
- You can no longer summon a pet during a siege.
- Minor changes in the rating interface and localizations in different languages.
- Disable aging of dominiums due to absence from the game.

Due to the situation in the world, we have decided to disable the "aging" of all dominiums in the game so that players who are currently unable to enter the game do not lose their homes. This is a temporary change and as soon as the situation improves, we will return this game mechanic back. We ask you to take this change with understanding!

notes.title: Major update Wild Terra Online. Rankings, Masters Mark Reforging and New Bonuses
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/3fe777d55569bc1db547d48381ce55e77697aee2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Rankings:[/h3]
- The basic version of the rating of players has been added to the game. For each server, the rating will be different, and it will be divided into 3 ranks: General (PvP + PvE), PvP activity, PvE activity. In the future, a rating for crafters/gatherers will be added.
- The old "Fame" system and everything connected with it are no longer active in the game.
- When committing suicide, the character will lose 20% of the Rating points.

[b]Now for PvP activity, players will receive Honor Points:[/b]
- For defeating a player, you get 10% of his Honor Points.
- For obtaining the head of a defeated character, you get 10 Honor points.
- For the construction of the “Head on a stake” decoration, you get 5 Honor Points.
- For capturing a castle during a siege, you get 20 Honor points. During the siege, you can only get honor points for one castle.
- When killed by another character, you lose 10% Honor Points.
- You can not get Honor Points for killing "Novices", as well as cutting off the heads of their characters.
- You can not get Honor Points if the character died from poison or bleeding.

[b]Now for PvE activity, you can get Fame Points:[/b]
- For receiving treasures and the Royal Treasure.
- For killing Bears, Draemeters, Alfar-Shamans, and other dangerous monsters.
- For the destruction of the Warp Crystal.
- For the successful interruption of the Ritual.
- When killed by monsters, you lose 10% Fame Points.

[b]Important![/b] For any dishonest manipulations with the rating and its cheating, the player's rating will be reset to zero. In case of repeated violation, the player will receive a ban!

[h3]Master's mark and item reforging:[/h3]
- Now you can reforge any item with a master's mark and get a new bonus instead of the old one. Only the master who made it can reforge an item (also requires an Intelligence of 13). It will require 50% of the cost of the resources that are needed to create this item + 10 Warp Crystal Shards and 3000 Master Inspiration points. The quality of the item and other characteristics do not change.
- Added more than 20 new bonuses for the master's mark.
- When crafting tools, you can get a unique master's mark bonus.

[h3]New mechanics and items:[/h3]
- Added a new profession "Weaving".
- Added new tool "Steel Shovel".
- Added "Roof Tile" to pottery.
- The mechanics of armor decoration scrolls has been reworked, now any scroll can simply be hovered over the desired item to change it. This will allow us to further add various paint options and other armor decorations to the game.

[h3]Balance and changes:[/h3]
- Changed the stamina cost of gathering and mining resources.
- To use the ability "Dash" and "Roll" now requires a minimum value of bonuses.
- Now you can build house projects directly from the project scroll.
- When destroying any stoves in the finished project of the house, the whole house will not be destroyed.
- Reduced time to remove dropped items on the ground from 30 to 3 minutes.
- Chat. The channel for the local language chat has been removed, now you can write to the global chat in any language without restrictions.
- Chat. Newcomers to the game cannot write to the chat for the first 10 minutes.
- Chat. Updated overhead message colors based on the chat channel.
- Royal treasures only appear in disputed lands.
- The old Penetration Protection perk no longer appears in item descriptions.
- Changed the color of nicknames above the head of players from the same guild.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a rare bug with Warping items.
- Fixed a bug with stamina costs when building some constructions.

notes.title: Christmas and New Year Event in Wild Terra!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/4d7dc36ddd2abe0fc63b227d1e3672ef0ac0e42f.jpg[/img]

Winter has come in the Wild Terra world. Snow fell, ponds were covered with ice and became passable. Collect snow, make snowballs, arrange snow battles.
But something is wrong here ... The inhabitants of the Corrupted Lands decided to wreck Christmas! A group of Woodwoses under the leadership of Grandfather Alfar in every possible way tries to interfere with the holiday, they cut down trees, steal Christmas decorations and Christmas presents. The holiday is at stake! Evil must be stopped!
Unfortunately, the monsters are protected by the strongest shamanic magic and only a snow fight is able to stop them ... The victory over the Christmas Woodwoses will give you various materials and decorations for the holiday, and if you take away "Stolen Christmas Gifts" from them, you can return them through auction and get valuable Christmas items!

- Decorate your dominium with Christmas decorations, and don't forget to set up a Christmas tree to receive gifts. First, you need to cut a good fir tree. But it’s not so simple, so prepare your very best ax and be patient. You can also try growing your fir tree forest to increase the chance of catching a good Christmas tree. After installing the Christmas tree, you can decorate it with toys and receive gifts for it (you can decorate a tree every 18 hours).
- To receive a Christmas gift from Santa Claus, you need to install a Christmas sock in your dominium and put snowflakes in it. The more snowflakes you put, the better the gift will be. Collect as many snowflakes as possible, and only then open the sock to see what lies there.

[h3]What's new in this event:[/h3]
- Added 20 Daily Christmas Quests with Stolen Christmas Gifts and Snowflakes rewards. You can only receive one task per day.
- Added 3 new Christmas character portraits. You can find them in the Christmas surprise box.
- Minor changes in crafting and construction of event items and buildings.
- Minor changes to the Christmas quest chain.
- Added a new effect "Frostbite", which slows down movement by 30%.
- Added ice arrows and sling projectiles with the "Frostbite" effect.
- Added a new curse "Christmas Curse".
- Added a new Christmas candy "Gingerbread Blue Star", which removes any curses. You can find it in the "Christmas Candy Bag".
- Added "Stolen Christmas Gifts" to any treasure loot.
- Added "Christmas Surprise" and "Christmas Candy Bag" to the loot of the Ritual Circle, Royal Treasure, and Draemeter.
- When you open locked Bronze, Iron and Steel chests, you can get "Snowflakes".
- Old Christmas gifts can be exchanged for iron ingots at the auction.

[h3]Changes to the unique quest chain "Santa's Orders":[/h3]
- Increased the total number of tasks in the chain from 15 to 20.
- Added a new character portrait as a reward.
- Added 2 new paintings to the reward.
- Added a new unique building Holiday fireplace as a reward. Which will change its appearance depending on the season and various holidays.

The Christmas and New Years event runs until January 11, 2022!

notes.title: Halloween 2021 at Wild Terra Online
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/6cd0d42bffd0868d02e5248f5210c33adae3add6.jpg[/img]

[b]Halloween 2021[/b]
- Cursed trees have begun to grow, on which you can hang Jack's Lantern to decorate. Each decoration calls the guards, which must be killed in order to be able to act further. After completely decorating and destroying all the waves of guards, you will receive a reward.
- The "Headless Guard" has appeared in the Corrupted Lands, it will not be so easy to defeat him, so call your friends and get better prepared for battle. If you still manage to defeat him, then you will have a chance to get a unique mount "Headless Guard's Fire Horse", as well as other, no less interesting items.
- Halloween items have been added to the auction in the “Events” tab, which can be purchased for Unholy Brains. It can be obtained from Unholy Monsters (Unholy Rat and Barghest also include).
- In your dominium, you can plant a "Sprout of a cursed home tree", and if you take care of it, then a "Home Halloween tree" can grow from it. If you decorate this tree with "Jack's Lanterns", it will remove all curses and you will receive a unique effect "Jack's Defense".
- Added a chain of Halloween quests, for completing which you can get the unique title "Scaring".
- Halloween pets and mounts can be exchanged for Demon Chests.
- Added "Demonic Chests" to the Royal Treasure, Ritual Circle and Draemeter rewards.
- Added Unholy Brains as a reward from Treasures.
- Cursed Brains can be obtained from the corpses of the Cursed Rat and Barghest.

Event date: from 10/26/2021 to 11/09/2021

[b]New items, decor and balance:[/b]
- Reduced the level of Unholy Bears in guarding "Unholy Trees".
- Minor changes in the Halloween quest chain.
- Added the new unique title "Scaring".
- Added Unholy Brains, which is used as currency at the auction in the "Events" tab. Unholy Leather is no longer needed, but you can exchange it for Cursed Brains at the Auction House.
- Added a new mount "Halloween Horse", in 4 different color schemes. You can get them by exchanging brains at the auction.
- Added 6 new Halloween avatars. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest" and by exchanging brains at the auction.
- Added 2 new Halloween paintings that can be placed on the wall. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Added 3 new Eternal Pumpkin Halloween Decorations that you can use to decorate your yard and will not disappear after the completion of this event. You can get it from the "Demonic Chest".
- Added several Jack Lanterns on a stick as decor to decorate your yard. You can find it in the "Building -> Halloween!"
- Added decorative cursed tree as a decor to decorate your yard. It will not disappear after the completion of this event. You can find it in the "Building -> Halloween!"

[b]Other changes and fixes:[/b]
- Changed quests in some chains of weekly quests, based on feedback from players.
- Fixed a bug due to which when catching animals for a quest, unsuccessful attempts to catch were taken into account.

notes.content:

notes.title: Major Update: Weekly quests, improvement of the interface and much more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/8cc0fa69800360a13e270d463c75b7ae8a5cda7e.png[/img]

[h3]Weekly quests:[/h3]
- Old quests have been redone and new ones have been added in the War and Worker chains.
- Added 2 new quest chains for Hunter and Gatherer. After completing which, you will receive unique titles, portraits and chests.
- Improved rewards in all chests for completing weekly quests.
Important! After installing this update on the server, all progress of the current weekly quests will be reset and you will have to complete all quests again this week.

[h3]Warping of items:[/h3]
- Completely reworked the mechanics of warping items with the Warping Scrolls. Now successful warping of items gives at least + 2% to the quality of the item, but at higher quality levels of the item, there is a chance to warp the item in the opposite direction and get -1% to the quality of the item. Also, warp requires not only the scroll itself but also 1 Fragment of the Warping Crystal.

[h3]Fragments of recipes and schemes:[/h3]
- Completely reworked the mechanics of fragments of recipes and schemes, which can be found in various godsends. Now, when studying a fragment, a still unknown recipe will open at the beginning. And if you already know all the recipes, then the fragments will increase the number of parts to obtain golden recipes.
- When transferred to your inventory, fragments of recipes and schemes no longer disappear and are separate items that can be read.
- Increased the number of fragments for obtaining golden recipes.

[h3]Bleeding:[/h3]
- Completely reworked bleeding mechanics. Now the chance of bleeding for knives and abilities works correctly, and a player in any armor can get bleeding.
- Added a new bonus - Protection from bleeding. Several types of light armor have received bleeding protection.
- Bleeding protection bonus can now be obtained when crafting any armor with a master mark.
- Added new plates for heavy and light armor with bleeding protection. You can find these items in a loot with other plates.

[h3]New items, buildings, bonuses:[/h3]
- Added a new type of poison - Slow Poison. Jars with this poison can be found in the loot where the usual poisons are.
- Added a unique bonus "Rare Loot Chance - Skinning". It increases the chance of getting rare resources (for example, animal heads) when skinning.
- Added a new type of coverage - Brick Paving.
- Added new types of buildings - Traps. At the moment, only hunter traps are available, which need to be built outside of their dominium and at a distance from each other.
- Added the corpses of Crows, Ferrets, Hares and Foxes as separate items that can be skinned. You can find them in the hunter's traps.
- Added potions to the game. This is a new type of drink that provides a unique buff. Only one effect of any potion can be active on a player at a time. You can find these potions in chests for completing weekly quests.

[h3]Mechanic and item balance:[/h3]
- Now you can skin tamed Crows, Ferrets, Hares and Foxes.
- Now stone paving can only be built inside your dominium. Also, the price for its construction has been changed.
- Reduced armor penetration bonus for Thozorium, Steel and Iron arrows.
- Changed the formula for restoring stamina from different types of satiety [1, 3, 5, 8, 12]. Now, if you have 5 different types of satiety, you will restore 12 stamina.
- Increased the number of minimum stamina consumption when collecting resources from 1 to 3.
- Increased consumption of stamina and durability of the tool during construction.
- If you successfully mine ore, you will not receive Stones that litter your inventory.
- Now, when crafting, you can get a bonus for a master mark only if you have 13 intelligence.
- When crafting weapons for hunters, you can get unique bonuses from the master's mark.
- Increased the durability of the hunting bow from 225 to 250.
- Hunting sausages now have a unique effect that increases damage to animals.
- Reduced base Inspiration and Mastery cooldown from 8000 to 5000 per day.
- Changed the duration of some premium scrolls. Simple scroll from 3 to 1 hours, Medium scroll from 6 to 3 hours, Quality scroll from 12 to 24 hours.
- Iron and Steel Ingots have been added to the daily quest chest rewards.
- Changed the stamina damage value from all poisons.
- Reworked the mechanics of penetrating strikes. Penetrating hits now work against any type of armor and can only be blocked if you have Penetration Protection.

[h3]Changes and improvements to the interface:[/h3]
- Now you can split items in a stack with an indication of the required number.
- Now, when moving items from any container to the inventory, at the beginning the ability to fill incomplete stacks of this type of item is checked. Works with the Take All button.
- Added history of interaction with the guild warehouse. Now, when taking any item from the guild warehouse, a record will be kept - who took what and when.
- Minor UI improvements in the quest and skills window.
- Added new categories in the crafting window for more convenient sorting of items.
- Updated 3D model for Crystal Shield.
- Updated item icons for Crystal Shield, Bow and Sword.

[h3]Automatic anti-cheat system:[/h3]
- The first iteration of the automatic anti-cheat system has been added to the game, which monitors and analyzes all player actions. If a player uses any prohibited software, bugs, or cheats, the system may issue him an automatic ban. It is important to understand that the system may not work perfectly and will be constantly improved based on the collected statistics. If you suddenly received a ban and are sure that you have not used anything, then write to us at support@playwildterra.com indicating your nickname and server..

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug, when catching animals, it sometimes turned out to catch them several at a time.
- Fixed a bug in the calculation of the stun chance.

notes.title: In the world of Wild Terra, the sacred season of Fertility and Rebirth is coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/4848a559782e38537c9266b3f2e59ea3110a039c.png[/img]

Easter Bunnies leave "Mysterious Eggs" of different colors everywhere. These eggs have different unique bonuses and when eating eggs there is a rare chance to find the Mysterious Needle, which gives the Rebirth effect and the unique title Reborn when it is used! Also in the Auction Events section, Mysterious Eggs can be exchanged for holiday items and some resources.
Harmful poachers started hunting Easter bunnies, and set traps everywhere for them. Thwart the poachers and free the bunnies from the traps, but be careful, there may be hungry wolves around such traps.

[b]Other changes:[/b]
- The use time of any drink has been increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.
- Reduced the time between attacks by 0.5 sec for all bolas.

notes.title: St.Wodwose's Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/d7fa620cf362d438c8d9ab00ae5993e4c62b2352.jpg[/img]

Begin to celebrate St.Wodwose's Day in the world of Wild Terra. It's time to try your luck!

For a long time, miners have noticed that in early spring, when mining ore, you can encounter small green wodwose. They are very shy and run away immediately, but because of their prey they run slowly and it is usually not difficult to defeat them. Take a look in their bag! You will receive an additional amount of random ore (including iron and thozorium!). Besides the ore, the Wodwose always carry the rare Lucky Four-leaf Clover with them. Also, clover can now be caught when picking wild flowers, and especially lucky ones can find lucky clover flowers.

[b]Special offer! Bag with 3,333 gold at a bargain price in the ingame store![/b]

[h3]St.Wodwose's Day Event![/h3]
- When mining any ore, there is a chance to encounter small green Wodwose.
- When collecting any wild flowers, there is a chance to find a rare type of lucky four-leaf clover.
- Lucky four-leaf clover has begun to grow in the world, real lucky ones will be able to find it.
- In the "Craft" window, the "Saint Wodwose Day" tab has appeared. There, you can make unique items and event food with the help of the lucky clover.
- Added 2 new rare "St. Patrick" avatars, which can be found in the Green Woodwos Bag or the Green Wodwose Chest.
- Added a new type of mount "Golden Calf", you can find it only in the Green Wodwose Chest.
- Added a Green Wodwose Chest, in which you can find rare event items and food that Green Wodwose love.
- Added Green Woodwos Chest to Draemetr, Ritual Circle and Royal Treasure loot.
The event will run until 03/26/2021 (inclusive)!

Congratulations to all women on International Women's Day on March 8! We wish that every moment of your life brings a sea of happiness, warmth, smiles and wonderful mood!

[b]Lady's Day Event:[/b]
- Beautiful flowers began to grow in the world - Gerbera, Chrysanthemum, Hydrangea. It’s can only be gathered during the event.

- Added 3 new types of paintings (you can find it only in the "Chest with gifts for a Lady").

- Now, when collecting any ore and coal in disputed territories, 10% tribute will be collected from each player in favor of the castle located in this territory. The size of the storage for storing tribute depends on the type of castle, the better the castle, the more resources it can store.
- Reduced amount gathered resources for the skill Carpentry and Skinning by 10%.
- Increased Iron Ore mining by 10%.
- The time for searching and opening any treasure has been reduced to 8 hours.
- Now you can cancel the active treasure, you can do this in the Cartography window.
- Added additional currency to the auction: Thozorium Ore, Hare Meat, Deer Meat, Honey.
- Now you can only do Suicide while sitting. "Accept death with dignity!"

- The time of using any drink is reduced to 1 sec.
- Carrot Juice, increased stamina recovery from 15 to 20.
- Grape Juice, increased stamina recovery from 20 to 30.
- Apple Cider, increased stamina recovery from 40 to 50.
- Red Wine, increased stamina recovery from 50 to 60.
- Waterskin, increased stamina recovery from 30 to 75.
- Mulled wine, increased stamina recovery from 80 to 100.
- The effect of Vegetable Stew and Bean Soup has been increased from 10% to 20%.

- Completely reworked the window for controlling a castle.
- A new "Treasure" tab has been added to the Cartography window, on it you can see which treasure is currently active, how much time is left before it disappears and, if necessary, cancel the active treasure.
- In the description of the Premium effect, added a description that it gives + 10% to the amount of gathering any resources.

notes.title: Major Update 10.12.591 and Christmas Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/87d29bed45950370860161ae4bf6ed9d2b496aa6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Christmas Event[/h1]
Winter has come to Wild Terra. Snow fell, rivers and lakes were covered with ice and become passable. Collect snow, make snowballs, and have snow battles!

But not everything is so simple... The inhabitants of the Corrupted Lands decided to disrupt Christmas! A group of Woodwoses under the leadership of Alfar tries in every possible way to interfere with the holiday, they cut down Christmas trees, steal New Year's decorations and Christmas gifts. The holiday is under threat! Evil must be stopped!

Unfortunately, the monsters are protected by the strongest shamanic magic and only a snow fight can stop them... Defeating the Christmas woodwoses will give you various materials and decorations for the holiday, and also, if you take the "Stolen Christmas gifts" from them, you can return them through auction and get valuable Christmas items!

- During the event, the "Premium" bonus gives + 10% to the mining of any resources.
- Decorate your dominium with Christmas decor, and don't forget to place a Christmas tree to receive gifts. First you need to cut down a good spruce tree. But it's not that easy, so prepare your best ax and be patient. You can also try growing your forest with fir trees to increase the chance of getting a good tree. After placing the Christmas tree, you can decorate it with toys and receive gifts for this (you can decorate the tree every 18 hours).
- To receive a New Year's gift from Santa Claus, you need to place a Christmas sock in your dominium and put snowflakes in it. The more snowflakes you place, the better the gift will be. Collect as many snowflakes as possible, and only then open the sock to see what is there.

[h3]What's new in this event:[/h3]
- Added Christmas sweets to craft.
- Added 5 types of Christmas mounts. You can find them in the "Christmas surprise" box.
- Added Christmas chocolate and champagne. Find them in the Christmas Surprise Box and in the Christmas Candy Bag.
- Added a new object "Forest Christmas tree" that will appear in the world. It can be decorated with Christmas decorations.
- Added a new object "Broken Snowman", which will appear in the world. If you restore it, you can try to find some gifts in it.
- Added a new object "Snowdrift with Lost Gifts", which will appear in the world. Try to excavate it.
- Added a new building "feeder for wild birds." If you build it, put food there, and return to it in a few hours, then the forest birds can thank you.
- Added 4 new unique "Framed Christmas pictures". You can get them by completing Santa's requests.
- Added a new type of unique decor "Christmas clock" that shows the time. You can get them by completing Santa's requests.
- Added a new unique building "Snow Machine", which produces snow from water. You can get it by completing Santa's requests.

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- The "Christmas Surprise" Box and "Christmas Candy Bag" have been added to the loot of the Ritual Circle, Royal Treasure, and with some chance to Draemeter.
- You can now put 10 snowflakes at a time in the "Christmas sock", instead of 1 as before. The maximum reward can be obtained if you put more than 1000 snowflakes.

[h3]Unique questline from Santa[/h3]
Added a new unique questline "Santa's Requests". To start it, you need to have a “Letter with instructions from Santa Claus” (can be purchased in the in-game store). By completing this questline, you will receive:
- 100 Snowflakes.
- 2 Christmas gifts.
- 4 unique framed Christmas paintings.
- Unique decor "Christmas clock".
- Unique building "Snow Machine".
- Christmas chocolate and champagne.
- A unique avatar.
- Unique title "Santa's Helper".

[i]The Christmas and New Years event runs until January 11, 2021!
[/i]

--------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Update 10.12.591[/h1]

[h3]General changes:[/h3]
- A general rebalancing of obtaining all resources has been made to increase their value.
- Now, when using the "Eat All" action, the duration is calculated from the amount of food you need to eat. Simply put, eating 20 apples will take longer than 2 Charlottes.

[h3]Changes to crafting, items and quests:[/h3]
- Now requires Bronze Ingots when crafting Thozorium Smelt.
- Reduced the number of metal ingots for creating arrowheads from 2 to 1.
- Added to craft "Arrows with a lightweight iron tip" and "Arrows with a sharp tip".
- Added to crafting "Light Bolas" and "Heavy Bolas".
- Added to crafting "Shards of Warping Crystal", and now you can disassemble crystal weapons into fragments.
- Increased the number of "Crystal Fragments" needed to create King Stele Parts from 10 to 40.
- Changed resources for the construction of "Head Stake", they also now blacken outside the dominium.
- Building "Auction" can no longer be built outside the dominium.
- The rewards in the War and Worker chests have been slightly improved.
- Made minor changes to the weekly War and Worker quests.

[h3]Changes to abilities and bonuses:[/h3]
- Now players wearing light armor spend 2 times more stamina when blocking.
- Bonus "Protection from penetrating blows" now depends on the quality of the item.
- Reduced the "Piercing Protection" bonus for heavy armors.
- Rebalanced the "Slow" bonus for all heavy armor and shields.
- Dash ability now ignores dodge and parry.
- The "Iron Whirlwind" ability has increased its hit radius and added bleeding effect.
- The number of arrows for the "Hail of Arrows" ability has been reduced from 10 to 5, the radius of the firing zone has been increased, the animation speed has been increased.

[h3]Weapon and Poison Changes:[/h3]
- Added a new type of bolas "Light Bolas".
- Rebalanced all bolas.
- Added "Battle Sling".
- Increased the firing range of the sling by 1 cell (from 5 to 6).
- Increased the range of the spear by 1 cell (from 5 to 6).
- Increased the firing range of some bows by 1 cell (from 6 to 7).
- Improved parameters for all crystal weapons and projectiles.
- Changed stamina cost on hits for axes, swords, and heavy weapons.
- Now any cursed weapon, when equipped, imposes a curse only once.
- Now all ritual and cursed weapons can be upgraded with overlays.
- Added a new type of ritual weapon - Knife and Mace.
- Changed additional damage from poisons to monsters and animals. Now each type of poison has its own.
- Changed the chance to poison on impact for all types of poisons and weapons.

[h3]Interface changes:[/h3]
- Added display of "Stamina cost" parameter in item descriptions.
- Improved and expanded description of poison parameters for jars of poison.
- Added additional parameters in the description of items in the crafting window.
- Updated icons for all ritual weapons.

notes.title: Halloween 2020 in Wild Terra Online
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/adb4a2d82762e5dbe190bd8845c0bb99dba84e63.png[/img]

- "Unholy Trees" have started to grow, on which you can hang "Jack-o’-lantern" to decorate it. Each decoration calls the guards, which must be killed in order to be able to act further. After completely decorating and destroying all the waves of guards, you will receive a reward.
- Halloween items have been added to the auction in the “Events” tab, which can be purchased with “Unholy Leather”. Unholy Leather can be obtained from Unholy Monsters (Cursed Rat and Barghest also included).
- In your dominium, you can plant a "Sprout of an unholy home tree", and if you take care of it, you can grow from it a "Homemade Halloween tree". If you decorate this tree with Jack's Lanterns, it will remove all curses and you will get the unique Jack's Defense effect.
- Added a chain of Halloween quests, for completing which you can get the unique title "Terrifying".
- Halloween pets and mounts can be exchanged for "Demonic Chest".
- Added "Demonic Chests" to the Royal Treasure, Ritual Circle and Draemetr rewards.
- Added "Unholy Leather" as a reward in Treasures.
- From the corpses of the Cursed Rat and Barghest, you can get the "Unholy Leather".
[i]The Halloween event will be divided into 2 stages, the second part will be launched a week after the start of the event.
Event date: October 27 to November 9[/i]

[h3]New items and decor:[/h3]
- Items. Added "Unholy Leather", which is used as currency at the auction in the "Events" tab. Unholy animal brains are no longer needed, but you can exchange them for Unholy Leather at the Auction House.
- Items. Added a new "Home unholy tree sprout", which is required for planting "Halloween home tree". The sprout from last year has long dried up.
- Items. Added 2 new types of Halloween food. You can find this food in the "Demonic Chest", as well as buy it at the auction.
- Items. Added 3 new Halloween avatars. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Items. Added 5 new Halloween paintings that can be hung on the wall. You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Items. Added 3 new Halloween pets (Boar, Wolf, Bear). You can get them from the "Demonic Chest".
- Decor. Added 7 types of Halloween decorations to decorate your territory. You can find it in the "Buildings -> Halloween!"

[h3]Changes and balance:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with the Jack's Defense effect.
- Made automatic removal of corpses from all monsters in the Corrupted Lands, after all loot has been taken from them.
- A new type of Draemeter has been added to the guards of the Warp Crystal.
- Reduced the number of players in a group from 7 to 5. This should slightly improve the optimization of the game, since a large number of players in a group significantly load the network flow between the servers and the client.

[h3]Dupe protection:[/h3]
- Added the first iteration of protection against creation and copying of items through some vulnerabilities in the game (dupe). It will help you to find and remove items that were not obtained in an honest way much faster.
- Added automatic deletion of things obtained by dishonest means (dupe). After removing the item, a message will appear above the character's head that this item was not obtained honestly and it was removed from the game. IMPORTANT! Deleted items cannot be recovered, even if you are sure that you did not do anything prohibited.

notes.title: More about the city, new locations, agriculture, bags. What we are working on
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b4ae49f146484ec7e1f50ee8639958e0a97bc9b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bags[/h3]
Developed and added bags that increase the number of slots in the inventory (depending on quality), but give a small penalty to movement speed. Bags are equipped in a slot and are displayed on the character's back, and only one bag can be equipped at a time. In addition to the usual bags, one exotic will be added, to which a lamp will be attached. The bags will appear in the game in the next update!

[h3]Central City[/h3]
Part of the territories and basic models of buildings and decorations were made. In the city, you will meet merchants and artisans from whom you can get various quests, sell special items, as well as purchase recipes and some consumables. Later, a bank with a warehouse will be added, and it will also be possible to purchase a home for furnishing, as well as fast travel.

We planned to release an update with the central city this summer, but due to the large volume of accompanying mechanics (NPC, currency, trade, quests, methods of obtaining currency, recipes unlocked for currency, etc.), the launch of the city is postponed to autumn.

[h3]Snow mountain territory and a new dungeon[/h3]
The story and monsters for the new location have been worked out. It will be a snow-covered mountainous area where guards live, holding back the onslaught of monsters from the dungeon. New quests, a new type of metal, new equipment, new monsters, and bosses are waiting for you!

[h3]Agriculture[/h3]
In the near future, will also take on Agriculture, and plan to launch it this month. A system of growing crops in several stages, plant breeding, use of fertilizers, tools, fight against pests, diseases, weeds, and soil depletion awaits you. The weather and seasons will also affect the harvest. Initially, only basic features will be available, and all of the above will be introduced into the game gradually.

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Get access and support Wild Terra 2[/url][/h2]

notes.title: WT2. Major Update 2.0.231. Cooking, pottery, improvements of the combat system
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36220547/4731aff3b383f2be6e223895be1c38f3bf02eefb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/4731aff3b383f2be6e223895be1c38f3bf02eefb.jpg[/img][/url]

[u]Cooking and pottery:[/u]
- Added buildings for cooking: Campfire with a cauldron, Cook's workplace, Stone and Brick ovens, Juice press.
- Added over 30 recipes and ingredients for Cooking.
- Added 5 drink recipes.
- Added various food and drink effects.
- Added buildings Potter's wheel and Pottery kiln.
- Added recipes for clay things: bowl, pot, jug, and bricks.

[u]Combat system and weapons:[/u]
- Health indicators are now automatically displayed above wounded enemies.
-  Added display of positive and negative effects applying to the enemy.
- The names of special attacks are displayed before the attack starts, to make the fight more interesting and manageable. Now you can react in a timely manner and take countermeasures.

*Some skills and perks will be able to partially or completely ignore absorption and defense.*
- Blunt weapons now have partial ignore absorption and defense.
- The ability "Hold the line" now increases the absorption of 2 times instead of absorbing all damage at all, but the duration has been increased.
- Abilities "Backstab" and "Shattered" now completely ignore absorption.
- Added ignore absorption and defense for some monsters and bosses.

- Reflected damage changed and weakened. The defense stat now correctly reduces reflected damage.
- The parry skill has been reworked to only work with a suitable weapon and the parry chance depends on the type of weapon.

- Now the flight speed of ranged ammo is different and depends on its type.
- Added recipes for arrowheads.
- Added iron and steel arrows.
- Added recipes for two new bows: Hunter bow and Composite bow.
- Bow stats have been rebalanced.
- Added 2 abilities for the skill Bows - slow, but strong shots, causing critical damage or injury.
- Added ability for the Throwing weapons skill - a throw that stuns a target.
- The passive ability "Weak Point" is now an ability of the Throwing weapon skill, not Bows.
- For bows, the passive ability “Bleeding Wound” has been added, causing bleeding.

Various protective effects have been added to the most powerful monsters:
- Resistant to any kind of injury, stun, slowdown, or all negative effects in general.
- Added partial reflection of incoming damage to the swamp boss "Devourer".

[u]What's new:[/u]
- In the game world, you can now find and collect berries: Blueberries, Lingonberries, and Wild Strawberries.
- Hazel and Wild Greens are also available for gather.
- Added Hives, from which you can get honey, as well as Nests of wild birds, for obtaining eggs and feathers.
- Increased player absence time before automatic packing of dominium.
- Added timers for using items, summoning pets and mounts.
- For pets, damage per second is now also displayed, which takes into account all bonuses received by the pet.

[u]Fixes and improvements:[/u]
- Made improvements to eliminate sudden impassable walls and improve movement within multi-story buildings. Need test.
- Fixed a bug due to which the effect of Rage on animals, monsters, and pets did not work as intended. It removes the delay between attacks, thereby significantly increasing the damage done per unit of time.
- Fixed a bug due to which during an attack, mining, or other actions, it was possible to change equipment.
- Fixed a bug due to which the doorway was not packed when moving the dominium to another location.
- Fixed a bug due to which some shields could not be displayed in the equipment window.
- Fixed a bug due to which arrows of stone statue flew over pets without causing them damage.
- Fixed timers for some abilities of monsters and bosses.
- Death from reflected damage is now taken into account in quests.
- Fixed a bug due to which stunning a skeleton with a shield could not be counted in the quest.
- Reduced damage dealt without weapons.
- Updated the appearance of the stone dominium and stone walls.
- In the crafting and building menu, all sections are collapsed by default.

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Get access right now and support the game[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Update 10.12.588. Chests rewards, warehouse signature, cut off heads and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/2dde7e81c8e4bf647d3e9b95d82a34475c42f3f7.png[/img]

[i]Despite the fact that Wild Terra 2 is now our main project, we will continue to update Wild Terra Online, add something new, fix the balance and errors. In the next major updates, we plan to add an interserver auction, Arena with tournaments and ratings with rewards for top places, as well as levels for guilds. Thanks to the development of WT2, a lot of new players are coming to WTO, and we plan to continue to make this game better, but unfortunately, major updates will come out quite rarely.[/i]

[h3]Update 10.12.588[/h3]
- Updated reward in all locked chests. Now there you can find new cloaks, mounts and scrolls for thozorium armor decoration.
- Now you can decorate your territoty with the cut off heads of the players' characters. To do this, you first need to build a special "stake for the cut off head", then take the desired head in your hand and set it to this stake.

[u]Abilities changes:[/u]
- Roll. Stamina costs increased from 6 to 10.
- Charge. Stamina costs increased from 10 to 20. Increased cooldown from 8 to 12 seconds. Increased the duration of the Slow effect from 5 to 7 seconds.

notes.title: Pets in Wild Terra 2. Catching, taming, leveling and breeding
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/72fdb48df0b3b2b07b7da6415ea9f9d80f3fd32f.png[/img]

In this article we will tell you more about the taming and leveling of pets, bonuses, as well as whether it is planned in a finished form.

[h3]Catching and taming[/h3]
To catch your future pet, you need to throw a created snare to an animal and slow it down (large individuals will need to be pre-loosened). The caught animal has the “Fear Level” parameter, and in order for the future pet to recognize you as its master, it is necessary to care for it and periodically feed it. For the successful catching and taming, the level of skill “Taming” is also important.

[h3]Leveling and bonuses[/h3]
Has your pet already recognized you as its owner? Great, it's time to start training him. Take it with you and while you are fighting, it is level-up along with you. Pets will have a number of their own features, characteristics and abilities, as well as some bonuses for the owner - all this will be unlocked with an increase the level of the pet. Some of the bonuses will be random, and it is possible to get extremely rare sets of features (and when breeding a new individual, features inherent in its nature will also depend on its parents, and the influence of chance will be less. [i]See Breeding and exchange[/i]).

[u]Examples of random bonuses for a fighting pet[/u]: special attacks and debuffs, a chance to inflict bleeding, increased damage, increased armor, small animals stop running away, wild animals do not attack, etc.
[u]Examples of random bonuses for a peaceful pet[/u]: a bonus to the growth of a specific peaceful skill of the owner, bonuses for gathering, etc.
[u]Examples of features known in advance (not random)[/u]: devotion (the inability to lose a pet at death), a bag for items, the ability to be a mount.

[h3]Breeding and exchange[/h3]
Among other parameters, all pets will also be divided by gender. Put two pets with different sexes of the same species in the pen, and after a while you can get a new one. The characteristics of the resulting pet will pretty much depend on the characteristics of its parents, but some of the abilities will still remain random.

For example, if you want to get a fairly strong “tank”, you should first create M and F pets, each of which will be have dominated protective features (bonuses to maximum health, protection, etc.). In this case, their pet is likely to have the best protective set of features.
Pets can also be exchanged with other players and sold at auction.
