notes.title: Celebrate Easter in the Wild Terra Online!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/7889c321bbe6b95222e358d6ac3fc4b17de5123e.jpg[/img]

In the world of Wild Terra, the holy season of Fertility and Rebirth has begun!

Easter Bunnies leave Mysterious Eggs of different colors everywhere. These eggs have different unique bonuses and when eating eggs there is a rare chance to find a mysterious needle that gives the effect of rebirth and the unique title of Reborn when applied! Also in the Auction Events section, Mysterious Eggs can be exchanged for holiday items and some resources.
Harmful poachers began hunting for Easter bunnies, and set traps on them everywhere. Prevent the poachers and free the bunnies from the traps, but be careful, there may be hungry wolves around the traps.

Sacred hares also appeared in the forests. If you are lucky to shoot him, then the Sacred Duck will appear. One legend said that there is a chance to get immortality if you kill such a duck. But you can get a curse for killing sacred animals!
At the time of the celebration of Easter, increased resource extraction by 10%, if you have a premium effect.

[b]New items in the game:[/b]
- Added 2 new event avatars. One can be bought at auction, the second can be found in the game.
- Added 5 new holiday dishes. Some dishes have unique properties.
- Added several event ingredients for cooking holiday dishes.
- In the "Create Item" a new tab "Easter", there you can find recipes for Easter dishes and items.
- All Easter items have a new rarity frame.

[b]New objects and quests have been added to the game:[/b]
- Added red, green and blue mysterious eggs, you can find them all over the map.
- Added object "Abandoned Easter basket", you can find them all over the map, but they are quite rare. Be careful when searching them, maybe this is a trap!
- Added object "Rabbit trap", you can find them all over the map. Free the caught hare and see what it has left for you inside.
- Added a chain of Easter quests, after which you will learn all the ways to get mysterious eggs.

[b]New bonuses and effects have been added to the game:[/b]
- Added new Easter Hare Curse.
- Added a new negative bonus "Chance of unsuccessful crafting". It reduces the chance of crafting or repairing an item, even if your skill level is much higher.

[b]Bug fix:[/b]
- Fixed bug with incorrect calculation of bonuses when receiving the effect of "Overeating".
- Fixed bug with incorrect calculation of bonuses when receiving some effects from food.

[b]Easter Event will be supplemented with new mini-events over time![/b]
[i]The event will last until April 27th, 2020 (inclusive).[/i]

notes.title: April Fools' Day Event! Pandora's Boxes and Fools Chests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/168ce8453c3b64613ba1176fadac1bf7711513ea.png[/img]

Crows behave very strangely, this is a bad omen...
If you manage to shoot them on time, then there is a small chance to get a huge rarity - Pandora's Box!

Also during the Iron Deposits mining, you can disturb the evil Woodwose miner. In Woodwose miners loot, you can find ore, various hats, as well as the legendary Fools chest! Which is guaranteed to contain one of all the existing hats in the game, and if the hat has quality, then it will be 150%!
In the Fools Chest, there are even unique hats from all the game events: Witch's Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Lucky Hat, and Christmas Hat. Try your luck!

- Deposits of iron at the time of the event are visible to everyone, regardless of the level of mining.

notes.title: Wild Terra 2. Reports from the devfield. Abilities and bonuses from skills
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/91f51dba7e32fbb2462ce971d2ec98cdf5ebc579.jpg[/img]

Implemented a system of passive abilities and bonuses that are unlocked at different skill levels. New abilities are displayed in the Book of Skills, message output is added when a level is received.

[h3]New bonuses and abilities:[/h3]
[b]Heavy armor.[/b] Main bonus: damage absorption.
Active ability "Tenacity". Reduces damage taken by half. Turns off running and slows down your movement.
Passive ability “Spikes”. Reflects some of the absorbed melee damage back to the attacker.
Passive ability “Blades”. Reflects even more absorbed melee damage back to the attacker.
[b]Light armor.[/b] Main bonus: evasion.
Passive ability “Dodge pace”. Briefly speeds up the movement after each successful dodge.
[b]Shields.[/b] Main bonus: block.
Active ability “Rise the shield”.Blocks all damage is taken if it does not ignore protection. Turns off running and slows down your movement.
Passive ability “Firm hand”. The shield continues to block even in stun.
Passive ability “Flexible arm”. The shield continues to block even from rear attacks.

[b]Blunts.[/b]
Passive ability “Blunt stun”. Chance to stun a target with usual hits.
[b]Knives.[/b]
Passive ability "Insidious blows". Hits from the back increase the chance to deal critical damage.
[b]Axes.[/b]
Passive ability "Axe wounds". Critical hits cause bleeding.

[b]Gathering, Skinning, Lumberjacking, Mining.[/b]
Passive abilities that increase the number of received resources of a certain skill.
Passive abilities that allow you to get some resources, even with unsuccessful mining.
Passive abilities that accelerate the process of extracting resources of a certain skill.
Passive abilities that additionally increase the number of received resources of a certain skill.

[b]Survival, Carpentry, Masonry, Leatherworking, Blacksmithing, Healing, Alchemy.[/b]
Passive abilities that accelerate the creation/construction process for a specific skill.
Passive abilities that allow you to gain experience at failure for Carpentry, Masonry, Blacksmithing.
Passive abilities that increase the lower limit of the quality of items for Carpentry, Masonry, Blacksmithing.

The list of active and passive skills will increase, unique features for each skill will be added!

[b]The next testing phase will begin on March 27![/b] Access for all owners of Conqueror, Hero, Creator packs, and their invited friends.

notes.title: St.Wodwose's Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/93b76890ded60e7c5747298126769c30a1948b78.jpg[/img]

[b]Begin to celebrate St.Wodwose's Day in the world of Wild Terra. It's time to try your luck![/b]

For a long time, miners have noticed that in early spring, when mining ore, you can encounter a small green Leprewose.
They are very shy and immediately run away, but because of their heavy bag, they run slowly, and it is usually not difficult to defeat them.
Look in their bag! You will receive an additional portion of random ore (including iron and thozorium!).
Also, Leprewoses always keep with them a rare kind of happy four-leaf clover, which can now also be found when collecting wildflowers. You can also purchase Clover in the in-game store.

- When mining any ore, there is a chance to encounter small green wodwoses.
- When collecting any wildflowers, there is a chance to find a rare happy four-leaf clover.

- In the "Craft" window, added a new tab "St.Wodwose's Day". There you can make unique things and event food with a happy clover.
- A hearty clover steak now does not drop upon death.
 Lucky Hat now has strength and will lose it when creating any item. But it can be repaired in the usual way, using repair kits or equipment repair scrolls. Old hats that were obtained at the last event have the strength to appear automatically when the item is first created.
- Added the “Green Wodwose Repair Kit”, which can be created in the “Craft” window and repaired the Lucky Hat with it.
- Added a new rare St. Patrick’s avatar, which can be found in the Green Wodwose bag.
- In the game store added sets of lucky clovers.

- Increased the number of Coal in one stack from 20 to 50.
- For the time of the event, the mining of all resources has been increased by 10%, if any "Premium" effect is affecting you.

[i]The event will last until 03/25/2020 (inclusive)![/i]

[h3]Special offer! Bag with 3,333 gold at a bargain price in the ingame store![/h3]

Reworked attack detection system. A number of related bugs fixed:

- Mobs could inflict damage to the player behind their backs.

Now, with a single attack, priority is given to the chosen target, if there can be pets or other targets at the point of impact.

Active work is underway to optimize the server and client, which should significantly improve performance already at the next test. Almost all elements of the game are analyzed and optimized: graphics, sounds, memory consumption, network interactions and synchronization.

notes.title: Update 10.12. Balance of poisons, bonuses for armor, changing rewards in chests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/5e386e9b42bf494eb2a4163feeca58d1f64250fa.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] All poisons have a reduced chance of poisoning the target from 20% to 10%. For weapons that already have poison, the chance of poisoning will be 20% until a new poison is used.
[*] Now all poisons do an additional + 10% damage to animals and monsters, with the exception of monsters that are immune to the poison.
[*] Now all Draemeters, Alfar Shaman and Wild Barbarians also have immunity to poison.
[*] Heavy bolases have a reduced chance to slow the target from 75% to 50%.
[*] Added a new bonus "Protection against slowdown".
[*] Changed the formula for protection from the "effect". In the beginning, the chance to get the effect is calculated, if the effect is received and the player has protection from this effect, then the protection is calculated in addition, if the protection worked, then the player does not receive this effect.
[*] Stores now have increased the number of slots for trading at the auction from 10 to 15.
[*] Now when crafting armor with the mark of the master, you can get an additional bonus, as well as when crafting weapons. Recall, in order to get an additional bonus for the item, when crafting, you must have: 12 intelligence and the required skill level for the recipe must be 40 or higher.
[*] Disabling the exchange of mounts for Christmas Gifts.
[*] Fixed the error with dropping Christmas sweets from the ritual circle.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which Christmas quests were not deleted.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/19f150a3e7a705164b1c9dc1652e25f4bd0ba88e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changed rewards in Bronze, Iron and Steel chests.[/h1]
Chests and keys can be collected from corpses, treasures, godsends, or purchased in the in-game store.

In the game there are three types of chests, each of which can be opened only with the appropriate key. The cost of the chests is different, however, the value of the reward in terms of gold remains the same. The reward and the chances of obtaining it in the chests are different and are proportional to it’s value.

The rare reward in the chests will change after a certain period of time (several weeks). Have time to receive unique rewards of this rotation!

[b]Bronze chest:[/b]
Guaranteed reward: Premium Scrolls, Potions.
Additional reward: Scrolls of Warp, Scrolls of characteristics, High-level food, Scale red cloak.
[b]The most valuable rare reward[/b] [i](it’s can only be obtained from this chest! Can not be obtained in any other way):[/i]
Fierce boar in red armor (speed 100)

[b]Iron chest:[/b]
Guaranteed reward: Premium Scrolls, Potions.
Additional reward: Scrolls of Warp, Scrolls of characteristics, High-level food, Scale green cloak.
[b]The most valuable rare reward[/b] [i](it’s can only be obtained from this chest! Can not be obtained in any other way):[/i]
Fierce boar in green armor (speed 100)

[b]Steel chest:[/b]
Guaranteed reward: Premium Scrolls, Potions.
Additional reward: Scrolls of Warp, Scrolls of characteristics, High-level food, Scale black cloak.
[b]The most valuable rare reward[/b] [i](it’s can only be obtained from this chest! Can not be obtained in any other way):[/i]
Fierce boar in black armor (speed 100)

notes.title: Wild Terra 2. Reports from the devfield
notes.content:
Launching a new section! Now 2 times a week we will talk about everything that we have managed to do since the last report, and sometimes about plans for the coming days. Let's go!

[list]
[*] Dragon and Cerberus mounts got a “Battle Cry" - emotion to intimidate the enemy, and added new sounds. Now mounts will menacingly growl and stomp.
[*] Heroes and Conquerors will be able to activate their keys to obtain mounts. Also, these animals now stand next to the owner on the character selection screen.
[*] We made the production buildings more convenient. The production status is displayed, and if fuel is used, a button for starting and stopping will also appear.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which sometimes it was not possible to pick up items and use a basket near the fence.
[/list]

Now we are working on adding new resources and Fishing. notes.title: Happy New Year and Merry Christmas! Wild Terra 2 - Update 2.0.97
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/a04f9dbdc8ea46b2051cdfc95384afe75dcdfc35.png[/img]

[b]Happy New Year and Merry Christmas! Especially for everyone who participates in early testing of Wild Terra 2, we have prepared special gifts![/b]

Until the end of the current testing phase, defeating the Orc Shaman, receiving awards from the Grave of the Executioner or the Chest in the church you will get the opportunity to try out all kinds of existing mounts, including those described below. You can also get Red Hat, Snow Staff, and Fireworks that you can launch into the sky!

[h2]Update 2.0.97[/h2]
[list]
[*] The executioner's grave has been added to the cemetery. To calm the soul of the executioner and open his grave, you will need to kill other players around. Defeat other players and you will get a unique Mask and executioner's Axe!
[*] Added objects that reveal the history of the world and various events: Executioner's gravestone, Cultists' holy book, Hunter's diary. Finding them, you can better understand what is happening in the game. The texts are still in preparation.
[*] Added mounts: Dragon of the Hero, Demonic dog of the Conqueror, Bloody bear, Zombie boar, wild boar, deer.
[*] Players can now express their emotions with body language and gestures. Added 14 different animations.
[*] Implemented adaptation of the screen interface for low screen resolutions.
[*] Added the effect of darkening and enlightening the screen to improve the display of transitions for entrances to dungeons, etc.
[/list]

Thank you for your mount ideas for Hero and Conqueror. We especially liked the idea of giving the Hero a princess. Unfortunately, the riding princess can be misunderstood in modern realities, so we decided to stay on the [b]Dragon[/b]. Heroes and dragons are made for each other. And only real Heroes can ride it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/cf911d45c4cf9fb3e9693c9ab876e98ff5e7b398.jpg[/img]

We decided to give the Сonquerors something aggressive, to match the rank. In the first Wild Terra, a common favorite was a barghest with a huge mouth, so we decided to stay on something similar, only better! So, meet - a huge [b]demonic Cerberus[/b]. In comparison with a barghest, there are 2 spare heads, 3 times more teeth, and a unique hot magma!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/ef4e1a57a9fdec1206d1d481f283c89e12529786.jpg[/img]

These mounts can in no way be obtained after the release, this is our thanks for initial contributors. All items and mounts that the pack owner receives will be available on all his characters, but they cannot be transferred to another account. It is worth noting that on one account you can activate the keys Hero, Conqueror and Settler at the same time if you want to collect unique bonuses from several packs.

notes.title: Dev Diaries #5. New skill — Bard. Toss a coin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/65d15cc0c845bc2648e98227443c1fa65c2aa164.png[/img]

We continue to talk about the development process of Wild Terra 2, about our ideas and the latest updates. This time, we will share our thoughts on a new skill - Bard.

Support the development and get access to testing right now: [url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]https://www.wildterra2.com/[/url]

[h2]Skill Bard[/h2]
We plan to expand the number of skills in Wild Terra 2, adding new roles and mechanics. One of these support skills will be Bard. In battle, they will be able to apply positive effects on allies (for example, Inspiration), and negative effects on opponents (reducing the chance of a critical attack, increasing the cost of stamina for abilities, forcing each of the opponents to throw one coin on the ground). There will also be positive effects for peaceful tasks - a temporary bonus to a successful chance of completing an action, increasing speed.

It is also planned to introduce joint performances of Bards, for example, to summon a special boss or activate an enhanced effect.

[h2]Have an idea?[/h2]
You can share your ideas on our Discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6]https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6[/url]

notes.title: Christmas Event in Wild Terra!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/71ce2b5ca1452d021051ea0aa7ac7d7fe56b62c4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Event "Christmas and New Year"[/h2]
Winter has come in the Wild Terra world. Snow fell, ponds were covered with ice and became passable. White mounts (Deer, Boar, Horse, Wolf, and Bear) put on their Christmas outfits. Collect snow, make snowballs, arrange snow battles.
But something is wrong here ... The inhabitants of the Corrupted Lands decided to wreck Christmas! A group of Woodwoses under the leadership of Grandfather Alfar in every possible way tries to interfere with the holiday, they cut down trees, steal Christmas decorations and Christmas presents. The holiday is at stake! Evil must be stopped!
Unfortunately, the monsters are protected by the strongest shamanic magic and only a snow fight is able to stop them ... The victory over the Christmas Woodwoses will give you various materials and decorations for the holiday, and if you take away "Stolen Christmas Gifts" from them, you can return them through auction and get valuable Christmas items!

- Was added a lot of Christmas tasks (30 quests). Follow them to get Christmas surprise and other Christmas items.
- Decorate your dominium with Christmas decorations, and don't forget to set up a Christmas tree to receive gifts. First, you need to cut a good fir tree. But it’s not so simple, so prepare your very best ax and be patient. You can also try growing your fir tree forest to increase the chance of catching a good Christmas tree. After installing the Christmas tree, you can decorate it with toys and receive gifts for it (you can decorate a tree every 18 hours).
- To receive a Christmas gift from Santa Claus, you need to install a Christmas sock in your dominium and put snowflakes in it. The more snowflakes you put, the better the gift will be. Collect as many snowflakes as possible, and only then open the sock to see what lies there.
- At the auction in the section "Events", there was an exchange of "Stolen Christmas Gifts" for event items.
- Added a new Christmas decor: flower beds with fir trees, paintings, several types of snowmen.
- Added blue Christmas cloak.
- Added 2 new sets of Christmas costumes (blue and green).
- Added 4 New Year portraits for the character.
- Added 5 new types of Christmas sweets (2 of them with new effects).
- During the celebration of Christmas, you can exchange some rare mounts for Christmas surprises. Important! Be careful before the exchange, and read the information in the exchange confirmation window. If you mistakenly “release” an animal, instead of an exchange, then we won’t be able to make compensation or restore items.
[i]The Christmas and New Year event will last until January 10, 2020![/i]


[h2]New features and other changes:[/h2]
- Increased the number of cells in the Stable by 5 places. Now a maximum of 40. This is the last increase in the size of the stable. In the future, we plan to add new buildings for storing mounts and pets (stalls, cages, corrals).
- Now you can release unnecessary mounts and pets, this can be done through the menu of interaction with objects. Important! Be careful and read all warnings before performing any action. If you mistakenly "release" your pet, then we will not restore it.
- Added "Dining table". Give your friends a hearty holiday dinner!
- Added a new type of decor "Pictures". You can install them through the menu of interaction with the item in the inventory. We plan to expand the list of decor, as well as to enable carpenters and blacksmiths to create individual pieces of furniture and sell it like ordinary items through an auction.
- Made minor improvements to the game interface.
- Some items and buildings now have a more detailed description.
- Fixed a bug with the appearance of a horizontal scrollbar in the auction interface.

notes.title: Dev Diaries #4. Seasons, weather, day-night cycle. Impact on the gameplay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/360ae794b22a7d280f11ce6ffa3ad5a578f44152.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/360ae794b22a7d280f11ce6ffa3ad5a578f44152.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/7094b2e0e920d93e4f42c75ed2a652f4571e69da.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3e70314a4c7c656010bbd0c9b84f7a90fbe67571.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/a6d7dbb480d46a29a8cbf0628edecb1148b2d7eb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/62dcffe820f6ffee537838366060edf065a21e9f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0f3c660e3526effe71f0f3d845d56901a844027c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/94b203dbabbb81f6b9a8b41ab9ac6889923bddd6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/fc59383ea35dde0cf5c8922ed56241c312e37ba1.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/461a128fd186baf8524c88158b0688d2bed5f11e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/58c4e6a5221cb6c31a298c6e0909557fa677e83f.png[/img][/url]

We added new effects for maximum atmosphere immersion: now, with the advent of winter, the game world will be covered by snow, and during the rain, the surfaces will become wet and raindrops will begin to fall from the roofs of houses. But we want to talk about the influence of weather, seasons and time of day on the gameplay Wild Terra 2: New Lands.

In Wild Terra 2: New Lands, weather and changing the time of day is not just a graphic effect, this will have a direct impact on the game. We will be guided by real-world experience and logic in order to add both major and minor changes. Below we will talk about some of our ideas. Please note that we are talking about ideas that are not a priority and may appear in the game much later. And yet, you can offer your ideas in our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6]https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6[/url]

[h2]Night[/h2]
Should I wait until morning, soaking hides for crafted leather and melting all rusted tools, or take a chance and go hunting? Surely you will ask yourself this question repeatedly. At night, your visibility will noticeably worsen, resources will be harder to find, and predator activity will only increase. Why get out of a warm couch? The answer is simple. Some locations and creatures will “come to life” only at night, and also, in the dark, the best conditions for robbery and theft.

[h2]Thunderstorm and fires[/h2]
During a thunderstorm, it is best to stay away from a lonely tree and not use metal weapons. There will also be forest fires in the game.

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
Be prepared for the fact that the rainy windy conditions will hardly be able to catch anything. But on an early sunny morning, your chances will increase many times over.

[h2]Harvest[/h2]
In the old days, people knew well that before the cold weather came, one had to start planning the spring. Until the ground is frozen, you can plant crops such as carrots and onions in order to harvest in the spring. But it is also better to take care of the food in winter in advance and store as much food as possible after the harvest season (do not forget to check stocks sometimes, rodents can be found in warehouses). However, in the hot summer, relaxation is also not possible, crops often need watering. And after rain, the growth of mushrooms and wild crops will accelerate.

notes.title: Dev. Diaries # 2. Dynamic change of character appearance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/26ff6168022a1b8b26fbcffb2dc31b8305912b2b.jpg[/img]

We continue to talk about the Wild Terra 2 development process, our ideas, and the latest updates. In this post, we will share our thoughts on the character’s customization in the game, and how its appearance can change over time.

Support development and access in December 2019:  [url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]https://www.wildterra2.com/[/url]

[h1]Character Creation and Dynamic Appearance[/h1]
When creating a character, you can choose gender, skin color, eye color, hair color, and hairstyle. This is a fairly standard set that you will not surprise anyone. In addition to choosing the parameters of the character when creating, we also plan to make dynamic parameters that will vary from certain actions, habits, and environments. Let's look at examples of how certain parameters can affect your appearance.

[h1]Get fat or lose weight[/h1]
If your character’s satiety is at the upper border most of the time, then the character will begin to gain weight. In addition to appearance changes, this will lead to faster consumption of stamina for action. Even the horse below you will tire faster. If you get fat to the maximum, then you have to look for new equipment. Only "chunky" artisans can do this because all measurements are done on their own. If satiety is constantly at the lower border, then your character will begin to deplete, which will lead to fatigue, deterioration of attentiveness (you will see fewer data about game objects and opponents), and even the appearance of hallucinations in, especially difficult cases. But do not worry, proper nutrition and alchemy can lead you back to normal.

[h1]Muscles[/h1]
Actions that require hard work, as well as the use of heavy weapons and armor, will increase the volume of your muscles over time. The not only appearance will change. This will help to increase the amount of stamina and the fastness of some heavy actions.

[h1]Hygiene[/h1]
In addition to the fact that in Wild Terra 2 the character will be able to cut his hair and shave his beard that grows over time, you will need to wash from time to time. If you neglect hygiene for a long time, your character will become dirty and will emit stench. When the character stinks a mile away, it is much more difficult to commit a successful theft or quietly sneak past predators.

[h1]Consequences of injuries[/h1]
Particularly severe critical hits can leave scars on the character’s body that will heal over time. The scars will be noticeable and can sometimes hurt, which for a short period of time can interfere with the rapid movement or stop the blow to the enemy. Using alchemy and rest from battles will help you recover faster. But some heavy scars will remain with you forever, and you can see the history - when and how exactly a scar was received.


[h1]Any other ideas?[/h1]
In the private Discord channel, you can offer your own, as well as vote on which of our ideas should be added and which ones should be abandoned. Our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6]https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6[/url]
To access closed channels, you could support the development by purchasing one of the sets: Settler, Conqueror, Hero.

When the character stinks a mile away, it is much more difficult to commit a successful theft or quietly sneak past predators.

Particularly severe critical hits can leave scars on the character’s body that will heal over time. The scars will be noticeable and can sometimes hurt, which for a short period of time can interfere with the rapid movement or stop the blow to the enemy. Using alchemy and rest from battles will help you recover faster. But some heavy scars will remain with you forever, and you can see the history - when and how exactly a scar was received.

notes.title: Event Halloween 2019 at Wild Terra!
notes.content:

[b]Event “Halloween”[/b]
- In the world of Wild Terra now there are Unholy Trees, on which you can hang the Jack o' lantern to decorate it. Each piece of decoration will summon a guard that must be killed in order to be able to proceed further. After fully decorating and destroying all waves of guards, you will receive a reward.
- At the auction, on the “Events” tab, Halloween items appeared on sale that can be exchanged for Unholy Animal Brains.
- Unholy animal brains can be obtained from unholy monsters. These also include the Corrupted Rat and Barghest.
- On your territory, you can plant a "Sprout of a domestic unholy tree" and grow from it a "Domestic unholy tree." If you decorate this tree with Jack o' lantern, then it will remove all the curses and you will get a unique “Jack Protection" effect.

[b]New Items:[/b]
- Items. New helmets "Witch Hat" and "Pumpkin Helmet" have been added. You can find them in a Demonic chest or buy at auction.
- Items. Added 5 new Halloween avatars. You can get them from a Demonic chest.
- Items. Added 5 new types of Halloween food. You can find this food in a Demonic Chest, as well as buy at auction.
- Items. Added the "Scroll of Eternity", it gives a unique effect of protecting the dominium from destruction and the title of "Eternal". You can buy it in the game store for gold.
- Mounts. A new type of Mount "Cursed Horse" has been added to the game. You can find it in a Demonic chest or buy at auction.
- Bonuses. The Curse Protection bonus has appeared - it reduces the chance of getting a curse by X%.

- Abilities. To use the Charge ability, you no longer need a target. Increased cooldown from 6 to 8 seconds. IMPORTANT! This is an experimental change, if players will like this change, we'll add it.
- Monsters. The Corrupted Rat and the Barghest are now considered as Unholy Monsters and affected by all effects and bonuses associated with the Unholy monsters.
- Loot. Added Demonic Chests to the Draemetr, Ritual, and Royal Treasures loot.
- Loot. From the corpses of the Corrupted Rat and Barghest, you can get Unholy Animal Brains.

notes.title: Grand Update 10.11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/68712b0956da8d33fb070656f65999d188c9235b.png[/img]

[b]New mechanics and items:[/b]
- The new mechanic Strange pointers. Now different pointers appear in different game zones, if you successfully learn this, you can get a pointer to a godsend or an iron / thozorium deposit. Also, instead of a pointer, you can get a piece of the map.
- There are 3 new godsends, it can be found by learning pointers.
- There are 2 new deposits of iron and one deposit of thozorium, you can find it by learning pointers.

- Now in general chat, you can write messages as emotions. It will be written in italics and highlighted in a different color. You can write an emotion by putting an " at the beginning and end of a message.

- Avatars. Now you can set the avatar image for your character through the Stats window.
Your avatar is visible in the guild list, friends list, and in the group window. Avatars can be obtained in various ways: for completing quests, found in treasures, received for various events, or bought in a store for gold.

- A chest with avatars has added to the game store. In it, you can find a random avatar from all currently available avatars in the game.

- Friend list. Now it is possible to add players to the "Friends List". When adding a player, he will receive a confirmation request. If you do not want to be added as a friend, there is a separate option for this.

- Now you can set the pointer to the current location of the player. This feature has been added to the "Guild Window" and "Friends List". IMPORTANT! The pointer is not updated when the player moves, it only shows the location at the time of its addition!

- Added "Injury" system. Injuries are divided into three types: Wounds, Bruises, Fractures. Different types of weapons can cause different types of injuries, all effects from injuries remain on the player until healed. A weapon can cause either a specific injury or random injury, this will be additionally indicated in the description of a weapon. Also now you can break the player’s jaw with bare hands.
IMPORTANT! This is an experimental system and in the future, it will change and be finalized.

- Monsters and animals can now cause injury. Be careful!

- A new skill for the treatment of injuries and negative effects - “Healing”. A separate tab has appeared on the list of crafting. This is the first skill, the recipes for which will be mainly tied to intelligence. Most of the ingredients require a mortar and pestle, which a blacksmith can make. The list of recipes will expand significantly in the future.

- Bonuses. A negative “Pain” bonus has been added - when you take damage, you get it X% more, where X is the value of the pain parameter.
- Bonuses. Added a negative bonus "Slowing attack speed" - reduces the speed of your attack by X%.
- Bonuses. Added negative bonus "Stamina cost at a run" - increases stamina costs while running by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a negative bonus "Stamina Costs on Attack" - increases stamina costs for attack by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a positive bonus "Protection against poisons" - reduces the chance of getting poisoning by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a positive bonus "Protection against injuries" - reduces the chance of injury by X%.

- Poisons. A new kind of poison, "Vomiting poison" - you gradually lose satiety and one positive effect of food.

- Items. A new bottle of "Vomiting poison" for use on weapons.
- Items. New plates and pads for armor with protection against injuries and protection against poisons.

- Added 54 new daily quests. Now the game has 125 daily quests.

[b]Changes and balance:[/b]
- Abilities. Increased Whirlwind strike radius from 75 to 125.
- Abilities. Increased Push strike damage from 110 to 125.
- Abilities. Increased cooldown of Suppression strike from 9 to 10 sec.
- Abilities. The parameters of the Stone Crusher have been changed. Increased cooldown from 12 to 15 seconds, increased stamina costs from 8 to 10, increased damage from 10 to 25%.
- Abilities. Rapid-fire parameters changed. Stamina cost increased from 16 to 20. Damage reduced from 100 to 90%, 0% crit chance for each shot.
- Abilities. Changed the parameters Barrage. Increased cooldown from 8 to 10 seconds. Damage increased from 140 to 200%.
- Abilities. Increased duration of the Protection (Shield) effect from 4 to 6 seconds.

- Weapons. All long-range weapons now have the "Range" option. Range = 1 cell in width, in grid mode ('G' key).
- Weapons. Hunting Bow has a 10% crit chance.
- Weapons. For Short Bow, a critical chance reduced from 20% to 10%.
- Weapons. For Composite and Thozorium Bows, crit damage has been reduced from 200 to 175% and crit chance from 20% to 15%.
- Weapons. Increased flight speed for a sling shell. Added stun effect. Reduced crit damage from 250 to 200%.
- Weapons. Spear flight speed increased.
- Weapons. Cursed Knife now ignores 20% of armor.
- Weapons. Reduced chance of triggering the effect of poisoned weapons from 25% to 20%.
- Weapons. Ritual weapons can now be repaired using any repair kits. You can also apply poison from a jar to this.
- Weapons. You can apply poison on a Cursed weapon.

- Equipment. Witch’s Cap and Pumpkin Helmet cannot be upgraded with plates and pads.

- Items. Increased the number of Unbaked bricks in one stack from 20 to 50.
- Items. Increased the number of Bricks in one stack from 20 to 50.
- Items. Increased the number of glue in one stack from 20 to 50.
- Items. Increased the number of Bones in one stack from 25 to 50.
- Items. Increased the number of Bones for the production of bone meal from 4 to 5.

- Curses. The Cursed Soul now stays forever until you remove this effect.

- Bonuses. The name of the bonus "Defense" has changed, now it is called "Armor".
- Chests. Changed rewards in bronze, iron, and steel chests. Now from these chests, you can get not only unique mounts, but also improvements for weapons and armor, poisons, spices, good food and much more.
- Godsends. In all godsends, the loot is slightly changed and the chance to get it

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
- Fixed calculation of speed with a bonus on dexterity and on items with a bonus to speed.
- Fixed a bug when players received an old scroll of premium for completing some quests.
- Fixed a bug when a player who made a transfer from another server was not removed from the guild list.
- Fixed a bug when a character who was deleted or moved to another server remained in the list of "access to the dominium" of other players.
- Fixed a bug with re-getting completed quests, after re-login to the game.
- Fixed a bug with the appearance Guards of Treasures in the territory of the dominiums.

- Weapons. Increased flight speed for a sling shell. Added stun effect. Reduced crit damage from 250 to 200%.
- Weapons. Spear flight speed increased.
- Weapons. Cursed Knife now ignores 20% of armor.
- Weapons. Reduced chance of triggering the effect of poisoned weapons from 25% to 20%.

- Outfit. Witch’s Cap and Pumpkin Helmet cannot be upgraded with plates and pads.
- Curses. The Cursed Soul now stays forever until you remove this effect.

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
- Fixed calculation of speed with a bonus on dexterity and on items with a bonus to speed.
- Fixed a bug when players received an old scroll of premium for completing some quests.
- Fixed a bug when a player who made a transfer from another server was not removed from the guild list.
- Fixed a bug when a character who was deleted or moved to another server remained in the list of "access to the dominium" of other players.
- Fixed a bug with re-getting completed quests, after re-login to the game.
- Fixed a bug with the appearance Guards of Treasures in the dominiums territory.

tags.feature:
- Avatars. Now you can set the avatar image for your character through the Stats window.
Your avatar is visible in the guild list, friends list, and in the group window. Avatars can be obtained in various ways: for completing quests, found in treasures, received for various events, or bought in a store for gold.
On the test server, you can see all avatars via chat commands:
/avatar wildterra
/avatar yusuf
- Friend list. Now it is possible to add players to the "Friends List". When adding a player, he will receive a confirmation request.

- Now you can set the pointer to the current location of the player. This feature has been added to the "Guild Window" and "Friends List". IMPORTANT! The pointer is not updated when the player moves, it only shows the location at the time of its addition!

- Added "Injury" system. Injuries are divided into three types: Wounds, Bruises, Fractures. Different types of weapons can cause different types of injuries, all effects from injuries remain on the player until healed. A weapon can cause either a specific injury or random injury, this will be additionally indicated in the description of a weapon. Also now you can break the player’s jaw with bare hands.
IMPORTANT! This is an experimental system and in the future, it will change and be finalized.

- A new skill for the treatment of injuries and negative effects - “Healing”. A separate tab has appeared on the list of crafting. This is the first skill, the recipes for which will be mainly tied to intelligence. Most of the ingredients require a mortar and pestle, which a blacksmith can make. The list of recipes will expand significantly in the future.
- Bonuses. A negative “Pain” bonus has been added - when you take damage, you get it X% more, where X is the value of the pain parameter.
- Bonuses. Added a negative bonus "Slowing attack speed" - reduces the speed of your attack by X%.
- Bonuses. Added negative bonus "Stamina cost at a run" - increases stamina costs while running by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a negative bonus "Stamina Costs on Attack" - increases stamina costs for attack by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a positive bonus "Protection against poisons" - reduces the chance of getting poisoning by X%.
- Bonuses. Added a positive bonus "Protection against injuries" - reduces the chance of injury by X%.
- Poisons. A new kind of poison, "Vomiting poison" - you gradually lose satiety and one positive effect of food.
- Items. A new bottle of "Vomiting poison" for use on weapons.
- Items. New plates and pads for armor with protection against injuries and protection against poisons.
- Added 54 new daily quests. Now the game has 125 daily quests.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25929018/27357ae456ff39595d26976fd1d9c84e1bc357d7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New in Update 10.10. Changes in repairs and new bonuses for items created by a Master
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/29af421a42afb846cbb74b64644589269c0e42a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]SUMMER SALE! Premium Packs at discounts up to 50%.[/h1]
[url=http://www.playwildterra.com/#showCaseScreen]On Wild Terra Online website[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/500710/Wild_Terra_Online/]On Steam[/url]
And on the in-game store.

[b]Changes and fixes.[/b]
- When repairing equipment of 145 quality and higher, an intelligence check is removed.
[i]After receiving feedback from the players about the new item repair system, we decided to completely rework it. At the moment we remove the requirement of intelligence in the repair, and any player with sufficient skill can repair their equipment as before. But in the future, we are preparing a new separate “market of services” for crafters, where they will be able to exhibit their services for other players (repair, creation or improvement of items). Any player without sufficient skill or intelligence will be able to use services of a crafter and get all his bonuses for a small fee and you will not need to go somewhere or give someone your items, everything will be available through this market.[/i]

- Now when crafting a weapon with a “master's tag”, this item will receive a random bonus to its characteristics, provided that the master has 12 intelligence and above. So far this rule is valid only when creating weapons that require a skill level above 40 (steel, noble and thozorium weapon, as well as composite bows).

- In the royal treasure guards, for the bear added the unique name "Barbarians Bear". To make it easier to find it, if a bear runs away.
- Fixed a bug with the auto selection tool when a lower quality tool was taken in hand.
- Fixed a bug in the auction, when buying a ritual weapon with a unique bonus or items with improvement or poison, these bonuses disappeared or changed. Now it works correctly.

notes.title: Pandora's Boxes are back! But only until July 1st
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/70a6679d66615fb8e3aef0398ca94eef6ef35d5e.png[/img]

[h1]The absolute bestseller is back to the game![/h1]
Pandora's Boxes can now be found in treasures or purchased in the in-game store.

[b]Pandora's box can contain anything![/b]
Opening it, you get only one thing, but it can be absolutely any of all existing in the game (from more than 750 items)! If a thing has a quality, then it will be equal to 150%. If a thing has a quantity, it will be equal to 1.

Opening Pandora's Box, you can find in it, for example:
A legendary cursed weapon or Barghest Mount or Thozorium Pickaxe (quality 150%) or Improve Scroll: Melee Weapon, but you can also get one Stick or one Carrot or even another Pandora's Box, as lucky. In the boxes there are also the rarest things that cannot be obtained in another way: Demonic chests, equipment from festive events, award items and much more!

Good luck with the boxes!

notes.title: Major Update 10.10. Legendary cursed weapons, new godsends and ~50 other changes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/9688dce56d52b654dff23289f34c0067c5879e10.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam-client will update automatically[/b]
[url=http://online.playwildterra.com/]Play directly in your browser (Chrome and Opera only)[/url]


[b]New in 10.10[/b]

[h1]New mechanics and changes in current:[/h1]
- A new system of interaction between items. Now, some items (repair kits, weapons poisons, etc.) can be dragged onto others to change or improve it. The description of such items will additionally indicate what can be done with them.
- New effects "Curses". There are curses in the game, this is a separate type of negative effects that constantly affect the player. You can remove it only with a purgation scroll, also, special altars will soon be added to the game, which will also remove curses and will be located throughout the map.
- New effects of poisons. There are several new effects of poison that affect the player in different ways. Now any kind of poison can be removed by antidote.
- Reworked system of bandages and removal of negative effects. Now, to remove the bleeding or poisoning you need some time to use the item.
- Added guards at the iron mines, now you can’t just pick up the iron ore from the mine. Also, now when you raise ore from the mine, your stamina is spent.
- Changed the parameters and behavior of monsters. Be careful, some monsters become more difficult!
- The ritual circle now appears only on Disputable Lands, the appearance time is increased to 12 hours. Also at one of the stages, the composition of the guard was changed.
- Guards of the Royal Treasure has been changed. Also, now when you digging a treasure, your stamina is spent.
- In all treasure hunts, the composition of the guard changed. When digging a treasure, more stamina is now spent.

[h1]Changes in skills and bonuses:[/h1]
- For all crushing weapons reduced the Ignore armor bonus from 40% to 30%.
- Now the Shield Block completely prevents all damage, unless the weapon does not have Shield Ignore bonus.
- For crushing weapons added a new bonus Shield Ignore. When a shield block is triggered, part of the damage will still apply to the enemy.
- Changed bonus Chance to block arrows, now with a block of arrows, this bonus is added to the total chance of a block.
- Reduced skills bonus armor for Light Armor and Heavy Armor. Skills bonuses will be completely reworked in the future.
- Reduced block chance with a shield if the character is wearing light armor.
- Reduced the overall speed of movement of the character by 10%.
- Reduced the recovery of health from the effect Rest from 5 to 2, but sitting, health is restored as quickly as before.

[h1]New items, buildings and objects on the map:[/h1]
- Added Repair kits, with which you can partially repair one item. You can find them in godsends, treasures and from the corpses of some monsters.
- Added Flasks with poison, with it you can apply poison on a weapon. The duration of the poison on a weapon is limited to charges. You can find Flasks in the treasures. At the moment there are 3 types of flasks with poison, but in the future, there will be much more.
- Added items to improve the characteristics of equipment and weapons, you can find it in treasures. Improvement gives a permanent bonus. Only one improvement can be applied to each item at a time. When using different improvements on one item, the old improvement will be deleted. This is an experimental version of the new system. If the players like it, in the future many new improvements will be added, as well as the possibility to create it with high Craft skill and intelligence.
- Added a legendary cursed weapon that can cast a curse when dealing damage to its target. Important! The owner of the cursed weapon also gets a curse when he takes it in his hands. All cursed items will be found in the Corrupted Lands from loot of different monsters.
- Added new improved buildings and stoves. For their construction requires rare construction drawings, you can find them in the Royal treasures. Total added 8 new buildings.
- Added books of experience for certain skills. When used, adds X experience for the specified skill. It can be found in treasures.
- Added new types of arrows: Cursed arrows, Poison arrows, Arrows with a sharp tip, Arrows with a thozorium tip. It can be found in treasures.
- Added sets of rusty iron and steel armor, which are suitable only for remelting in a furnace. It can be found in various godsends.
- Added new items to remove the negative effects: Antidote, Laxative, Scroll of ritual purification. It can be found in various godsends and treasures.
- Added a new type of godsends - Bloodied Corpse, you can find valuable things in it.

[h1]Changes in items, buildings and objects on the map:[/h1]
- Reduced the copper bucket bonus of the resources received from 7 to 5.
- All wooden shields have the chance of a block of arrows changed and the total chance of a block is lowered.
- Added the chance of a block of arrows to a simple wooden shield and increased Durability from 525 to 750.
- Crystal club, steel and thozorium pickaxes now have bonus Shield Ignore (when a shield block is triggered, part of the damage will still apply to the enemy). 
- Increased produced iron ore from untreated ore from 8 to 10.
- Increased the bonus effect Bretzel from 10 to 20%.
- Increased the bonus effect Venison Steak from 10 to 20%.
- Increased the amount of "Mulled Wine" when crafting from 1 to 2.
- Reduced stamina recovery from Strong Liqueur effect from 5 to 3.
- Godsends are now divided into 3 types: broken cart, old corpse, a godsend. Each of them will have its own type of loot, for example, in a broken cart, it will most often be possible to find some resources and materials.
- To all Crystal Weapons added a new bonus Additional damage to durability. Now using this type of weapon can be much faster to break the equipment of the enemy.
- Slightly reduced the additional damage at all arrows. Some arrows got new bonuses.
- Completely changed the reward in all types of treasures.
- Completely changed the reward in the Royal treasure.
- Completely changed the reward for the Ritual Circle event.

[h1]Errors and bugs:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug with several scrolls to improve characteristics - the timer did not work correctly.
- Fixed a bug when a character sitting started to get up while eating.
- Fixed a bug due to which the "Equipment Repair Scroll" did not repair items with 0 durability.
- Fixed a bug with perk "Restores health at critical damage."
- Fixed a bug with getting fractional damage by players.

notes.title: Soon in Wild Terra: New Buildings, Upgrade Equipment and Experience Books
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/b26a1dd5cf5757d7e52d6c8a770f343f193460cb.jpg[/img]

[i]Everything described hereafter - still in development or exists only in the plans. Remember that a lot can change and the dates may be delayed. We will do everything to make changes better and timely.[/i]

We are working on adding new buildings to the game: Cage for pets, Stall, Barn, Brick Warehouse. Some of the buildings will represent improved versions of current (more cells, more expensive construction), and some - simplified (fewer cells, cheaper construction).

A new mechanic will be added to Wild Terra - Upgrade equipment and armor.
Only one upgrade can be applied to each item at a time. This upgrade gives a permanent effect.
Some examples of upgrades:
[list]
[*] Steel grindstone = +5% damage.
[*] Lightweight handle for an ax = decreases attack cooldown by -0.2 sec.
[*] Convenient knife handle = +5% parry.
[*] Light plates for heavy armor = +2% movement speed, but -4% armor.
[/list]
We also plan to add experience books for certain skills. For example: "Carpentry Tutorial" - when used, adds X experience points to Carpentry.

notes.title: Update 10.9. Ritual weapons, unique pets, repair scrolls, and more
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/5e386e9b42bf494eb2a4163feeca58d1f64250fa.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam-client will update automatically[/b]
[url=http://online.playwildterra.com/]Play directly in your browser (Chrome and Opera only)[/url]

[h1]Congratulations on Victory Day! World peace![/h1]
Special Offer for Victory Day! Save up to 40% on [url=http://playwildterra.com/#showCaseScreen]Premium-packs.[/url]

[b]New in 10.9[/b]
New rewards added to the Ritual:
- Ritual axe. Does not break at 0 durability. With a unique random melee weapon bonus.
- Ritual sword. Does not break at 0 durability. With a unique random melee weapon bonus.
- Captivated Draemetr. Unique pet.
- Tamed Barghest. Unique pet.
- Light iron arrows. Flight speed is much higher than normal.

Implemented a system of random bonuses for melee weapons:
- Restore the durability of a weapon when killing a target.
- Restore stamina when dealing damage.
- Restoring health at critical damage. 
All bonuses depend on quality, so this can be improved by improving the quality of the weapon.
At the moment, these bonuses can be obtained and tested only on the Ritual Axe and on the Ritual Sword, but we plan to expand this system of bonuses in the future, giving bonuses also for crafted items.

Implemented scrolls for the repair of equipped items. This scroll can repair rare things that can not be created by yourself, as well as quickly repair damaged equipment in the case when there is no time to search for the necessary resources.
Partial repair scrolls can be obtained with some chance in Ritual, loot from a Draemetr, and also in the Treasure. Full repair scrolls are available in the game store.

We remind you that this week you can perform a chain of quests of Battle and get the Warrior Chest and the unique title Warrior.
In the Warrior's Chest you will find one of the Ephemeral weapons whose quality can reach 160%!
There is also a chance to get unique Ephemeral spears, which are so light that their number in a cell can reach 200, and the flight speed is much faster than normal.
Ephemeral weapons can not be repaired and improved, it has relatively low durability, but its quality and damage more than compensate for its shortcomings.
Also in the chest you will find 3 types of high-quality projectiles for slings, spears, or arrows, and you can also find food for battle, scrolls of warp for weapons and armor, armor decoration scrolls, Battle concentration potion, etc.
Warrior's Chest can be obtained as a reward for completing the Ritual, and is also available in the game store.

Now 50 solutions for Leatherworking are placed in one cell.
The respawn time of Draemetr is returned to normal.
Fixed a bug due to which new types of shields did not block the arrows from monsters and guards of treasure.
Fixed a bug due to which the negative effects of monsters were activated when triggered a shield block.
Fixed a bug due to which the chain of Battle quests could be issued again.

notes.title: Major Update 10.8. Guardians of Ritual, Ephemeral Instruments and Labor Day!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/41063814c2968d4f1540231c67127c3c5e9c7d01.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam-client will update automatically[/b]
[url=http://online.playwildterra.com/]Play directly in your browser (Chrome and Opera only)[/url]

[h1]Only until May 6th! Save 25% on Regent Pack [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1019300/Wild_Terra_Online__Regent_Pack/]on Steam[/url] or in the in-game store.[/h1]

Evil from the Corrupted Lands seeks to expand its possessions!
A new world event - Ritual! Look for the Circle of Ritual in the world to interrupt it!
You will need considerable effort because the time to kill the Guardians of Ritual is limited. We recommend assembling a team of 5-6 people.
If you manage to do everything in time, the Master of the Ritual will appear and for the victory, you will receive a valuable reward and the title of Exorcist (given to only one player who opened the chest with the key of the ritual).
Let us know your impressions and opinions about the event and its rewards. It is not yet final, we continue to develop new content, but here is a list of new items that you can find there now:
- Craftsman Belt. Increases the quality of created items by 5%. 6 additional slots.
- Unique gold decorated Thozorium armor. High quality.
- Unique decorated Thozorium riveted leather armor. High quality.
- Light wooden shields with a different pattern. 100% chance to block arrows.
- Guards Cloak of various colors. Don’t drop at death.
- Arrows with a tip from a crystal. Deals additional damage to armor durability in PvP. 50% ignoring absorption. Incremental damage +5.

In the world, you can now find an abandoned mine with iron ore. Mining skill for its mining is not required

Implemented a system of weekly successive quests with a reward for completing the entire chain.
The next chain of quests will be issued at the beginning of the siege or bidding for Castles.
If you did not manage to finish the chain, then it will disappear and you will not be able to receive the final reward.

The Labor Day is approaching and this week the chain of Labor and its reward starts - Worker’s Chest and Worker title. Next comes the chain of quests of the Warrior and its reward - the Warrior's Chest and the title Warrior.
In the Worker Chest, you will find one of the Ephemeral tools with the quality up to 160%!
The ephemeral tool cannot be repaired and improved, it has relatively little durability, but with its help, you can significantly increase the chances of success of complex operations, which will greatly speed up your leveling speed.
Also in the chest, you will find 3 types of quality materials, spices or food for mining and crafting, and you can also find schemes, Scrolls of Warp for tools, potions of Master inspiration, etc.
Worker’s Chest can be as a reward for completing the Ritual and is also available in the game store.

Changed the content of the reward for winning Draemetr. The change is not final, we continue to work on new content for the monsters of the Corrupted Lands and the Treasure.
During the testing of the Ritual, the Draemetr appears every 3 hours after death.
Now, when a new Draemetr appears, a world alert is displayed.

Information about the size and access to the weekly quests has been added to the dominium notes in the Building window.
Reservoirs of Inspiration master and Battle concentration increased to 30,000 units.
The time limit for small and medium potions of the Master's Inspiration and Combat concentration has been removed, and the big ones now fill 7,500 units.
Different scrolls of increase characteristics can now be used simultaneously.
Hurry to spend the accumulated Mysterious eggs, the auction will stop taking them on May 3.
Introduced some adjustments in the behavior of Corrupted Lands monsters.
Rewards for monsters of the Corrupted Lands are no longer scattered on the ground but are available through its corpses.
Fixed a bug due to which the first quest in the list as shown, and not the one that was clicked.
Fixed errors due to which some materials were not visible at the auction.
Fixed errors leading to incorrect operation of fertilizers.
Fixed a bug due to which negative effects could not be imposed during the cooldown of evasion.
Fixed a bug due to which the Cartography window did not open if the player is sitting.

notes.title: Update 10.7. Happy Easter!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/7889c321bbe6b95222e358d6ac3fc4b17de5123e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Congratulations to all of the upcoming Easter![/h1]
In the world of Wild Terra comes the sacred season of Fertility and Revival.

[b]Steam-client will update automatically[/b]
[url=http://online.playwildterra.com/]Play directly in your browser (Chrome and Opera only)[/url]

At this time, treasure hunters often see the mysterious Sacred Hare crawling out of the chests (can also be found in the woods).
If you are lucky to shoot him, the Sacred Duck will appear from it.
Not everyone will be able to catch it, but the luckiest will get the Mysterious egg in one of three colors: red, green or blue.
Eating these eggs, you get the following bonuses
- Red mysterious egg: increase the chance of catching birds and animals by 10%
- Green mysterious egg: acts when you water a plant, increases the future harvest by 20%.
- Blue mysterious egg: acts when you water a plant, increases the chance of ripening by 20%.
When eating eggs, there is a rare chance to find the Mysterious Needle, which gives the effect of Revival and the unique title Reborn after its use!

In the Events section of the Auction, Mysterious Eggs can also be exchanged for holiday items:
- Pet Sacred Duck.
- Pet Sacred Hare.
- Mount Sacred Bull (speed +100%).
- A unique Hat of Farming and Taming, accelerating the germination and maturation of all plantings after their watering and processing, as well as reducing the time until the next feeding at taming by 30%.
- Abundance chest. In it, you can find Sacred Animals, Farming and Taming Hat, Mysterious Eggs, Potions and Scrolls, Spices, Various Foods, Culinary Ingredients, Seeds for Farmers, Traps, and Lures for Fishing. Try your luck!

The revival effect is implemented:
- Acts until the first death.
- Does not disappear when leaving the game.
- Items from the inventory after death do not drop out.
- The durability of the equipment does not decrease at death.
- There is no cooldown time for the revival on the bed.
- After revive, health and stamina are fully restored.
- It works only for death from animals and monsters, for suicide or death from other players does not work, but it is not wasted.

Implemented Revival Scroll, it can be found in chests and treasures, as well as purchased in the game store. Unlike the Mysterious Needle, this scroll does not give the title Reborn.

Those who could not collect enough Mysterious Eggs can purchase it at the game store.
The event will last until April 30.

notes.title: Update 10.6. April Fool's Day
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/ce54bb97d9434f21b3fdc4b0d0d99ae56ee06f7e.png[/img]

[b]Steam-client will update automatically[/b]
[url=http://online.playwildterra.com/]Play directly in your browser (Chrome and Opera only)[/url]

[h1]Celebrate Fools' Day![/h1]

Crows behave very strangely, this is a bad omen ...
If you manage to shoot them in time, then there is a small chance to get a huge rarity - [b]Pandora's Box![/b]!

Pandora's box can contain anything!
Opening it, you get only one thing, but it can be absolutely any of all existing in the game (from more than 700 items)! If a thing has a quality, then it will be equal to 150%. If a thing has a quantity, it will be equal to 1.

Thus, opening Pandora's Box, you can find in it, for example:
Premium Scroll for 30 days or Barghest mount or Thozorium Pickaxe (quality 150%), but you can also get one Stick or one Carrot or even another Pandora's Box, as lucky.
Good luck with the boxes!

Beware! During the event, when mining iron, you can disturb an angry Wodwose Miner.
Beating a Wodwose Miner you can get ore, various helmets and hats, as well as the legendary [b]Fools Chest[/b]!
Fools chest is guaranteed to contain one of all the existing helmets and hats in the game, and if an item has quality, it will be equal to 150%!
There are even unique hats from all game events in the Foolish Chest: Witch Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Lucky Hat and Christmas Hat. Try your luck!

Fools chests and Pandora's Boxes are also available in the in-game store.
The event will end on April 2nd. Hurry up!

Deposits of iron at the time of the event will often appear and be visible to everyone, regardless of the level of mining.
Improved display of pop-up descriptions for items.
Due to a critical error, weapon damage on cupboards on PvP servers is temporarily disabled.
Fixed a bug due to which the contents of the inventory was not updated after summoning a pet.

[u]SPECIAL OFFER! A pot of 3,333 gold at the best price! Already in the in-game store[/u]

[b]Update 0.10.5. St.Wodwose's Day[/b]
Begin to celebrate St.Wodwose's Day in the world of Wild Terra. It's time to try your luck!
For a long time, miners have noticed that in early spring, when mining ore, you can encounter a small green Leprewose.
They are very shy and immediately run away, but because of their heavy bag, they run slowly, and it is usually not difficult to defeat them.
Look in their bag! You will receive an additional portion of random ore (including iron and thozorium!).
Also, Leprewoses always keep with them a rare kind of happy four-leaf clover, which can now also be found when collecting wildflowers. You can also purchase Clover in the in-game store.
Collect lucky clovers and you will be able to create unique items and food of St.Wodwose:
- Lucky Hat. Unique headdress. Gives a chance to create a recipe without the cost of resources. Does not drop at death. When you create it, will unlock the unique title “Lucky”!
- Cloak of Luck. Unique. Does not drop at death.
- Salad of Luck with clover. Increases the chance of successful wrap (improving the quality of equipment) by 10%.
- Green Ale. A refreshing drink that allows you to see all the resources on the map, even if you still do not have enough skill.
- Hearty steak with clover. A very satisfying festive dish that does not require cooking skills.

Improved autodetection of speedhack.
The system is still being tested and only truly malicious violators get into the ban, but we continue to improve its work.
In honor of the holiday, all those banned for speedhack will receive amnesty, but be aware that with a repeated violation you may lose your account forever.
We remind you that any non-gaming ways of getting gaming advantages are unacceptable. Only fair play!

Increased the base bonus on Enchanted tools to 130%.
Enchanted tools now have quality and can be improved with Scrolls of Warp or Improvements Scrolls to increase their bonus.
An enchanted hammer can now be used for blacksmith recipes with Thozorium.
The bonus tool is now written next to the quality of the item.
Fixed a rare error, due to which it was impossible to get out of the saddle even after re-entering the game.

[i]The kits contain: unique mounts, premium bonus, tools, game currency and more.[/i]

[b]Update 0.10.4. Lady Day[/b]
With the arrival of spring, we celebrate Lady Day in the Wild Terra world.
The number of wildflowers in the world has doubled.
Wildflowers can be dried on Herb drying racks, to obtain material for the manufacture of a unique Maiden's Cloak, which can only be worn by ladies.
To make it, you will need to collect and dry the flowers, make Floral fibres out of them with Flax break, and then create a cloak using scissors and a Loom.
The one who makes this cloak will receive the unique title Enamored.
Спешите, изготовить уникальный плащ и получить уникальное звание можно только до 15 марта!

Changed the following abilities:
- "Roll". Reduced the cooldown from 20 to 15 seconds.
- "Charge". Increased Increased stamina cost to 10.
- "Pounce". Increased Increased stamina cost to 10

Changed bolas mechanics:
Bolas are now divided into 2 types. Normal and heavy.
The default slowdown chance for a normal bolas is 50%, for a heavy 75%.
Every 2 levels of the skill "throwing weapons" add 1% to the chance of slowing down when using a bolas, so 100% chance will be only with a heavy bolas and maximum skill of throwing.
The duration of a slowdown in a normal bolas is 6 seconds, in a heavy 12.
The delay between the throws in a normal bolas is 2 seconds, in a heavy 2.5.
Now “Dodge”, “Block” and “Parry” are triggered when attacking with a bolas if the player is standing on the ground and not in the saddle.
When hit by a player who is in the saddle, the bolas will knock him out always, even if the slowdown has not been applied.
The number of bolas in one cell is reduced from 6 to 3.
Changed recipe for making a normal bolas.
Above the player's head now appears the inscription if he received a "Slowdown" or "Stun".
If the animal or monster has received a slowdown, the inscription also appears.

Now the “Duke” of the guild can lower itself if there is another Duke in the guild.
Removed buttons for quick removal of items from the hands, because in the heat of battle it’s were sometimes accidentally pressed, which led to the loss of valuable equipment.
Fixed a bug due to which the "Knight" could lower any player in the guild.
Fixed a bug due to which unknown recipes looked like normal in the list.
Fixed a bug due to which the ability to scroll the list of recipes was lost.
Fixed a bug due to which the negative effect of the monsters of the Corrupted Lands was applied, even if a dodge attack was triggered.
Fixed a rare bug that caused an unscheduled reboot the server.
Fixed a critical error, due to which in rare situations the effects of a mount and sitting on the ground were applied at the same time, which required the death of the character to continue the normal game.

notes.title: INTERPOINT - upcoming sci-fi adventure. Parallel worlds, secret organizations and Photon Gun!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1002020/extras/Interpoint-Steam-gif.gif[/IMG]

Friends!
Juvty Worlds now not only makes games, but also supports other indie developers, publishing their interesting games.

[h1]INTERPOINT - Spring 2019 on Steam Early Access![/h1]
Interpoint is a first-person sci-fi mystery with elements of psychological horror. A secret organization made the discovery of parallel worlds. You are Harry G., a scientist, who took part in a project that was supposed to benefit all of humanity.

Announcement Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hilDN_iLub8

Add the game to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002020/INTERPOINT/

[u]Welcome to Delta Labs![/u]
In the early 2020s, the Delta Laboratories research corporation created the Quantum Entanglement Device, which allows opening portals to countless parallel universes, but all other worlds discovered were either an almost exact copy of ours, or completely surreal worlds with unknown creatures. You are a scientist who took part in creating a project that was supposed to benefit all of humanity, but something went wrong. One day, you find yourself stuck far away from home.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Photon Gun is a key element of gameplay. The device is able to absorb energy from surrounding objects (light from bulbs, gamma radiation from radioactive puddles, force fields in laboratories, etc.) and transform it into something else.
[*] Underground science complex and a journey through parallel worlds. Explore, search for answers and solve puzzles.
[*] Many solutions. Interact with objects, find secret passages, use all the features of the Photon Gun.
[*] Twisted story with several levels of depth, conspiracy and various endings.
[/list]

[b]Improvements and fixes 0.10.2[/b]
Completely changed the system of effects from food, the previous bonuses for skills no longer apply.
The food is now divided into several types, some good for saturation, and some for getting positive effects.
Some effects are combined in the groups "Wel-fed warrior" and "Energy drink", which excludes their simultaneous use.
The remaining effects can be applied simultaneously, but if you try to apply more than 4 types at the same time, you will receive a short-term "Overeating".
Continuing to eat with Overeating, you lose all the current active effects of food! Do not overdo it with food, overeating is harmful!
Cooking skill can now be increased to level 50.
Added new drinks: Carrot Juice, Fruit Juice, Dry Wine, Strong liquor.
Added new pottery: Clay Jug.
Skill level requirements for Cooking recipes have been reworked.
Added a new kind of spices - Sugar. It can be obtained in the same way as all other spices: Godsends, Yellow chests of daily quests, Treasures and monsters of the Corrupted Lands.

Changed the mechanics of the Absorption for heavy armor.
Now Absorption reduces all incoming damage always, but its value for heavy armor slightly reduced.
Iron and steel arrows, as well as Crystal Sword can now partially ignore the Absorption parameter.
Swords have been improved, damage has been added and Parry values have been increased, which should significantly increase the survival of swordsmen.
The ballista can now be destroyed only with a crushing weapon, so now you can safely use any other weapon in its defense without fear of inflicting random damage on it.
Equipment damage at the death reduced to 10%.
Copper, Wool and Scraps of cards have been added as additional currencies for trading.
Fixed click area of the steel chest.
Fixed a bug due to which the chance of repairing decorated items was not displayed.
Fixed errors in the descriptions of skills, attributes and parameters of items.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/500710/Wild_Terra_Online/]Purchase on Steam[/url]

[b]Improvements and fixes 0.10.1[/b]
To improve trade, we have introduced the ability to sell products not only for spices.
Now you can choose the currency of sale for the goods from several options of resources.
Now you can create lots to buy these resources in large quantities.
Now you can sell spices for other resources, to accumulate them on the balance of your store and collect them as needed.
Regulate the economy of your server, set your exchange rate, compete with other sellers!
Products that are on sale, you need to pick up from the store and set the sale again, otherwise they will not be visible at the auction.
An additional bookmark has been added to the stores where you can collect the accumulated proceeds.
Reworked display of goods at the auction, the choice of the sale currency was added to the auction filter.
The current mechanics of trade is not final, we will analyze the results and change this mechanic, if necessary.
We are looking forward to your feedback and ideas on what other selling currencies should be added. Write on our forum on Steam.
Commission for instant delivery of things from the auction reduced by 2 times.
Fixed a bug due to which the Bolas was not visible at auction.
Many types of resources and items increased their number, which fits in one cell.

Christmas gifts and quests extended until January 14.

For the year of operation of current server configurations, we analyzed all the data and decided to abandon the separation of servers into Hardcore and Standard.
All servers will now work under the new rules, only the division into PvP and PvE will be preserved, but new mechanics will be added.
Worn items of equipment no longer fall out if you die, but take damage of 15% of its durability.
Now the item is marked on the damage panel in red when it reaches 20% durability, so you can understand that it is approaching destruction at death and can avoid its loss.
Durability limit for all items increased by 50%, and for shields (iron and higher) by 100%, but the current value of remains the same, do not forget to repair it.
Dependencies of resource visibility on attributes are no longer present, but the visibility of resources based on Gathering and Mining skills has been added.
If your skill level is 10 levels below the required resource level, you will not see it. With a difference of 9 levels, the chance to find a resource will be 10% and so on up to 100%.
The skill levels of a number of Mining recipes and some resources requiring the Gathering and Mining skills have been changed.
Maximum gathering level increased to 30.
Storages of Battle Concentration and Master Inspiration are 25,000; basic replenishment per day is 8,000.
The power of animals and monsters is reconfigured so that at the initial levels it does not cause inconvenience to the players, but at the maximum combat level their power could be compared to the strength of Hardcore servers.
The rate of skill improvement, mining volumes and endurance replenishment are reduced to average balanced values.

Features of PvE servers:
All containers are locked, players cannot damage each other and player buildings, cannot pick up the contents of another's corpse and cut off their heads.
There are no mines; instead of sieges, weekly Castle Auctions are held.

Features of PvP servers:
Only high-level containers and warehouses are locked.
Entry-level structures as well as fragile structures can be destroyed by other players.
Players can kill each other, collect the contents of other corpses and cut off their heads.
Iron production is reduced, additional iron is obtained from the daily mines.
Weekly Castle Sieges.

notes.title: Hardcore PvP has become easier. Avanium server will be closed soon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25929018/5e386e9b42bf494eb2a4163feeca58d1f64250fa.jpg[/img]

[b]We decided to simplify the rules of the game on Hardcore PvP servers in order to attract more players.[/b]

All resources are now visible, which makes it possible for the player to be both a warrior and an artisan.
Wearing equipment no longer drops after death, so that you can use the most valuable equipment in battle.
The other parameters remained unchanged on Hardcore PvP.
As an experiment for balancing PvP, the requirement of light armor for the onslaught ability has been removed.
Slightly reduced the cost of steel for the manufacture of elements of Noble armor, sword and shield, to more closely match it's characteristics.
We are waiting for your feedback on new server settings and balancing!
Fixed the bug of pressing masks for complex objects, in particular, for the iron lattice.

[b]On January 15, the Avanium server will be closed[/b], which once became a haven for all players in the early access stage who did not want to create a new character when the game was released.
The rules of Avanium almost completely corresponded to the Hardcore PvE server, but the move from it was not available, so that on new servers everyone would have equal conditions for starting.
A lot of time has passed since then and now we can safely invite players from Avanium to other servers.
Before transfer do not forget to take out all the items from the stores, if you put them up for auction.
To transfer, type the /transfer command in the chat. Your dominium with all the buildings will be packed and placed in your inventory.
After that, select the server where you want to transfer.
Note that if you transfer to a server where you already have a character, this character will be deleted.
After transfer, clear a suitable place and expand your dominium from the inventory.

notes.content:

[h1]Free DLC Royal Treasures![/h1]
[i]DLC has already added to the main game, just update it to the latest version.[/i]

[u]New dominium of huge size - Royal Dominium.[/u]
In addition to the usual ingredients, its creation will require Thozorium ingots and fragments of the Warp Crystal from the Corrupted Lands.
